<usage_guidelines>

- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.
</usage_guidelines>

<notes>

- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)
</notes>

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Entities/Ectn.cs">
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Entities;

/// <summary>
/// ECTN Aggregate Root – Electronic Cargo Tracking Note.
/// Encapsulates all domain invariants and state transitions.
/// </summary>
public class Ectn
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; private set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; private set; }
    public EctnStatus Status { get; private set; } = EctnStatus.Draft;

    public string? EctnNumber { get; private set; }
    public string? RejectionReason { get; private set; }
    public string? CancellationReason { get; private set; }

    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; private set; }

    public DateTime? SubmittedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ReviewedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? ApprovedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? IssuedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? RejectedAt { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? CancelledAt { get; private set; }

    public ICollection<EctnParty> Parties { get; private set; } = new List<EctnParty>();
    public ICollection<EctnStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; private set; } = new List<EctnStatusHistory>();
    public ICollection<EctnDocument> Documents { get; private set; } = new List<EctnDocument>();

    // Required by EF Core
    protected Ectn() { ApplicationReference = string.Empty; }

    public Ectn(Guid tenantId, string applicationReference, EctnType type, Guid createdBy)
    {
        if (tenantId == Guid.Empty) throw new ArgumentException("TenantId cannot be empty.", nameof(tenantId));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(applicationReference)) throw new ArgumentException("ApplicationReference cannot be empty.", nameof(applicationReference));
        if (createdBy == Guid.Empty) throw new ArgumentException("CreatedBy cannot be empty.", nameof(createdBy));

        TenantId = tenantId;
        ApplicationReference = applicationReference;
        Type = type;
        CreatedBy = createdBy;

        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Draft, createdBy);
    }

    // ─── Domain Behaviours ───────────────────────────────────────────

    public void Submit(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only draft ECTNs can be submitted.");

        Status = EctnStatus.Submitted;
        SubmittedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Submitted, actorId);
    }

    public void StartReview(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only submitted ECTNs can be placed under review.");

        Status = EctnStatus.UnderReview;
        ReviewedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.UnderReview, actorId);
    }

    public void Approve(Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Submitted && Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");

        Status = EctnStatus.Approved;
        ApprovedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Approved, actorId);
    }

    public void Issue(string ectnNumber, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Only approved ECTNs can be issued.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectnNumber))
            throw new ArgumentException("ECTN number is required for issuance.", nameof(ectnNumber));

        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
        Status = EctnStatus.Issued;
        IssuedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Issued, actorId);
    }

    public void Reject(string reason, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status == EctnStatus.Issued || Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled || Status == EctnStatus.Expired)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
            throw new ArgumentException("Rejection reason is required.", nameof(reason));

        RejectionReason = reason;
        Status = EctnStatus.Rejected;
        RejectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Rejected, actorId);
    }

    public void Cancel(string reason, Guid actorId)
    {
        if (Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled || Status == EctnStatus.Expired)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN is already cancelled or expired.");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
            throw new ArgumentException("Cancellation reason is required.", nameof(reason));

        CancellationReason = reason;
        Status = EctnStatus.Cancelled;
        CancelledAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus.Cancelled, actorId);
    }

    public void AssignEctnNumber(string ectnNumber)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectnNumber))
            throw new ArgumentException("ECTN number cannot be empty.", nameof(ectnNumber));

        EctnNumber = ectnNumber;
    }

    public void AddParty(EctnParty party)
    {
        if (party == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(party));
        Parties.Add(party);
    }

    // ─── Private Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    private void AddStatusHistory(EctnStatus status, Guid actorId)
    {
        StatusHistories.Add(new EctnStatusHistory
        {
            Status = status,
            ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ChangedBy = actorId
        });
    }
}

<file path="tests/Customs.UnitTests/Application/ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using Moq;
using FluentAssertions;
using Customs.Application.Commands;
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.UnitTests.Application;

public class ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ICustomsDbContext> _dbContextMock;
    private readonly Mock<ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator> _numberGenMock;
    private readonly ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler _handler;

    public ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _dbContextMock = new Mock<ICustomsDbContext>();
        _numberGenMock = new Mock<ICustomsCaseNumberGenerator>();

        _numberGenMock
            .Setup(x => x.Generate(It.IsAny<Guid>()))
            .Returns("CASE-2026-001");

        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(1);

        _handler = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandHandler(_dbContextMock.Object, _numberGenMock.Object);
    }

    // ── Happy path ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_ReturnsNonEmptyGuid()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        result.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_AddsCustomsCaseToContext()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        _dbContextMock.Verify(x => x.AddCustomsCase(It.IsAny<CustomsCase>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_CallsSaveChanges()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        _dbContextMock.Verify(x => x.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    // ── Generated case number is stored ──────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_UsesCaseNumberFromGenerator()
    {
        CustomsCase? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddCustomsCase(It.IsAny<CustomsCase>()))
            .Callback<CustomsCase>(c => captured = c);

        _numberGenMock
            .Setup(x => x.Generate(It.IsAny<Guid>()))
            .Returns("CASE-CUSTOM-999");

        var command = BuildCommand();
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured!.CaseNumber.Should().Be("CASE-CUSTOM-999");
    }

    // ── Data mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_MapsAllFieldsToCustomsCase()
    {
        CustomsCase? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddCustomsCase(It.IsAny<CustomsCase>()))
            .Callback<CustomsCase>(c => captured = c);

        var command = BuildCommand();
        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured.Should().NotBeNull();
        captured!.TenantId.Should().Be(command.TenantId);
        captured.DeclarationExternalId.Should().Be(command.DeclarationExternalId);
        captured.DeclarationNumber.Should().Be(command.DeclarationNumber);
        captured.ECTNExternalId.Should().Be(command.ECTNExternalId);
        captured.EctnNumber.Should().Be(command.ECTNNumber);
        captured.ProcedureCode.Should().Be(command.ProcedureCode);
        captured.ImporterReference.Should().Be(command.ImporterReference);
        captured.ExporterReference.Should().Be(command.ExporterReference);
        captured.DeclarantReference.Should().Be(command.DeclarantReference);
        captured.PortOfEntry.Should().Be(command.PortOfEntry);
        captured.PortOfExit.Should().Be(command.PortOfExit);
        captured.CountryOfOrigin.Should().Be(command.CountryOfOrigin);
        captured.CountryOfDestination.Should().Be(command.CountryOfDestination);
        captured.CreatedBy.Should().Be(command.UserId);
    }

    // ── Initial status ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_CustomsCaseStatusIsReceived()
    {
        CustomsCase? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddCustomsCase(It.IsAny<CustomsCase>()))
            .Callback<CustomsCase>(c => captured = c);

        await _handler.Handle(BuildCommand(), CancellationToken.None);

        captured!.Status.Should().Be("Received");
    }

    // ── Validator ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_ValidCommand_PassesWithNoErrors()
    {
        var validator = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator();
        var result = validator.Validate(BuildCommand());
        result.IsValid.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_EmptyTenantId_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.TenantId = Guid.Empty;

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "TenantId");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_EmptyDeclarationNumber_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.DeclarationNumber = "";

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "DeclarationNumber");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_EmptyProcedureCode_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new ReceiveDeclarationCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.ProcedureCode = "";

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "ProcedureCode");
    }

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    {
        TenantId              = Guid.NewGuid(),
        DeclarationExternalId = "DECL-EXT-001",
        DeclarationNumber     = "DECL-2026-001",
        ECTNExternalId        = "ECTN-EXT-001",
        ECTNNumber            = "ECTN-2026-001",
        ProcedureCode         = "IM4",
        ImporterReference     = "IMP-REF",
        ExporterReference     = "EXP-REF",
        DeclarantReference    = "DEC-REF",
        PortOfEntry           = "MOG",
        PortOfExit            = "JIB",
        CountryOfOrigin       = "SO",
        CountryOfDestination  = "DJ",
        UserId                = Guid.NewGuid()
    };

<file path="tests/Customs.UnitTests/Domain/CustomsCaseTests.cs">
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using FluentAssertions;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.UnitTests.Domain;

public class CustomsCaseTests
{
    private static readonly Guid TenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
    private static readonly Guid UserId   = Guid.NewGuid();

    // ── Constructor sets defaults ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_ValidArguments_SetsPropertiesCorrectly()
    {
        var customsCase = new CustomsCase(
            tenantId:             TenantId,
            declarationExternalId:"DECL-EXT-001",
            declarationNumber:    "DECL-2026-001",
            ectnExternalId:       "ECTN-EXT-001",
            ectnNumber:           "ECTN-2026-001",
            caseNumber:           "CASE-001",
            procedureCode:        "IM4",
            importerReference:    "IMP-REF",
            exporterReference:    "EXP-REF",
            declarantReference:   "DEC-REF",
            portOfEntry:          "MOG",
            portOfExit:           "JIB",
            countryOfOrigin:      "SO",
            countryOfDestination: "DJ",
            userId:               UserId);

        customsCase.TenantId.Should().Be(TenantId);
        customsCase.DeclarationExternalId.Should().Be("DECL-EXT-001");
        customsCase.DeclarationNumber.Should().Be("DECL-2026-001");
        customsCase.EctnNumber.Should().Be("ECTN-2026-001");
        customsCase.CaseNumber.Should().Be("CASE-001");
        customsCase.ProcedureCode.Should().Be("IM4");
        customsCase.ImporterReference.Should().Be("IMP-REF");
        customsCase.ExporterReference.Should().Be("EXP-REF");
        customsCase.DeclarantReference.Should().Be("DEC-REF");
        customsCase.PortOfEntry.Should().Be("MOG");
        customsCase.PortOfExit.Should().Be("JIB");
        customsCase.CountryOfOrigin.Should().Be("SO");
        customsCase.CountryOfDestination.Should().Be("DJ");
        customsCase.CreatedBy.Should().Be(UserId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_DefaultStatus_IsReceived()
    {
        var customsCase = BuildCase();
        customsCase.Status.Should().Be("Received");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_OpenedAtUtc_IsSetToNow()
    {
        var before = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(-1);
        var customsCase = BuildCase();
        var after  = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(1);

        customsCase.OpenedAtUtc.Should().BeAfter(before).And.BeBefore(after);
        customsCase.CreatedAtUtc.Should().BeAfter(before).And.BeBefore(after);
    }

    // ── Default collections ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_Collections_AreInitializedEmpty()
    {
        var customsCase = BuildCase();

        customsCase.Assessments.Should().BeEmpty();
        customsCase.Valuations.Should().BeEmpty();
        customsCase.Holds.Should().BeEmpty();
        customsCase.Discrepancies.Should().BeEmpty();
        customsCase.Decisions.Should().BeEmpty();
        customsCase.StatusHistories.Should().BeEmpty();
    }

    // ── Default CaseType ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void DefaultCaseType_IsImport()

<file path="tests/Customs.UnitTests/Domain/CustomsStateTransitionPolicyTests.cs">
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;
using Customs.Domain.Policies;
using FluentAssertions;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.UnitTests.Domain;

public class CustomsStateTransitionPolicyTests
{
    private readonly CustomsStateTransitionPolicy _policy = new();

    // ── CanTransition: valid paths ────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Received,          CustomsStatus.ValidationPending)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.Rejected)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment,    CustomsStatus.Assessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment,    CustomsStatus.InspectionPending)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment,    CustomsStatus.NoInspection)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.InspectionPending, CustomsStatus.Assessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.NoInspection,      CustomsStatus.Assessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Assessment,        CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed,      CustomsStatus.PaymentPending)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed,      CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.PaymentPending,    CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed,  CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview,   CustomsStatus.Cleared)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview,   CustomsStatus.Rejected)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Cleared,           CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized, CustomsStatus.Released)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Assessment,        CustomsStatus.Held)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.PaymentPending,    CustomsStatus.Held)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview,   CustomsStatus.Held)]
    public void CanTransition_ValidTransition_ReturnsTrue(CustomsStatus from, CustomsStatus to)
    {
        _policy.CanTransition(from, to).Should().BeTrue(
            because: $"transition {from} -> {to} is a valid customs workflow step");
    }

    // ── CanTransition: invalid paths ─────────────────────────────────────────

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Received,      CustomsStatus.Released)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Released,      CustomsStatus.Received)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Released,      CustomsStatus.Assessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.PaymentPending, CustomsStatus.Received)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Held,          CustomsStatus.Released)]
    public void CanTransition_InvalidTransition_ReturnsFalse(CustomsStatus from, CustomsStatus to)
    {
        _policy.CanTransition(from, to).Should().BeFalse(
            because: $"transition {from} -> {to} is not an allowed customs workflow step");
    }

    // ── EnforceTransitionRules: happy path ───────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_ValidTransition_DoesNotThrow()
    {
        var customsCase = BuildCase("Received");

        var act = () => _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(customsCase, CustomsStatus.ValidationPending);

        act.Should().NotThrow();
    }

    // ── EnforceTransitionRules: invalid transition throws ────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_InvalidTransition_Throws()
    {
        var customsCase = BuildCase("Received");

        var act = () => _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(customsCase, CustomsStatus.Released);

        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("*Invalid state transition*");
    }

    // ── EnforceTransitionRules: unrecognised status string throws ────────────

    [Fact]
    public void EnforceTransitionRules_UnknownStatusString_Throws()
    {
        var customsCase = BuildCase("INVALID_STATUS_XYZ");

        var act = () => _policy.EnforceTransitionRules(customsCase, CustomsStatus.ValidationPending);

        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("*Invalid or unrecognized*");
    }

    // ── Full workflow path: Received -> Released ─────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void FullWorkflow_ReceivedToReleased_AllTransitionsValid()
    {
        var workflow = new[]
        {
            (CustomsStatus.Received,          CustomsStatus.ValidationPending),
            (CustomsStatus.ValidationPending, CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment),
            (CustomsStatus.RiskAssessment,    CustomsStatus.Assessment),
            (CustomsStatus.Assessment,        CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed),
            (CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed,      CustomsStatus.PaymentPending),
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentPending,    CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed),
            (CustomsStatus.PaymentConfirmed,  CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview),
            (CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview,   CustomsStatus.Cleared),
            (CustomsStatus.Cleared,           CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized),
            (CustomsStatus.ReleaseAuthorized, CustomsStatus.Released),
        };

        foreach (var (from, to) in workflow)
        {
            _policy.CanTransition(from, to).Should().BeTrue(
                because: $"{from} -> {to} must be valid in the full release workflow");
        }
    }

    // ── Exempt-payment path: DutyAssessed -> ClearanceReview ────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void ExemptPayment_DutyAssessedToClearanceReview_IsValid()
    {
        _policy.CanTransition(CustomsStatus.DutyAssessed, CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview)
               .Should().BeTrue(because: "exempt goods skip payment and go straight to clearance review");
    }

    // ── Hold transitions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.Assessment)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.PaymentPending)]
    [InlineData(CustomsStatus.ClearanceReview)]
    public void Hold_FromActiveProcessingState_IsValid(CustomsStatus from)
    {
        _policy.CanTransition(from, CustomsStatus.Held)
               .Should().BeTrue(because: $"holds must be placeable from {from}");
    }

    // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static CustomsCase BuildCase(string status) =>
        new()
        {
            Status = status,
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CaseNumber = "CASE-001"
        };
}

<file path="tests/Customs.UnitTests/Domain/CustomsValuationPolicyTests.cs">
using Customs.Domain.Entities;
using Customs.Domain.Enums;
using Customs.Domain.Policies;
using FluentAssertions;
using Xunit;

namespace Customs.UnitTests.Domain;

public class CustomsValuationPolicyTests
{
    private readonly CustomsValuationPolicy _policy = new();

    // ── TransactionValue method ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_TransactionValue_CIF_NoExchange_ReturnsCorrectValue()
    {
        // CIF = invoice + freight + insurance + additions - deductions
        // 1000 + 150 + 50 + 0 - 0 = 1200, exchange=1 => 1200
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 1000m,
            freightValue: 150m,
            insuranceValue: 50m,
            additions: 0m,
            deductions: 0m,
            exchangeRate: 1m);

        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(1200m);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_TransactionValue_WithExchangeRate_ConvertsCorrectly()
    {
        // CIF = 1000, exchange=3.65 => 3650
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 1000m,
            freightValue: 0m,
            insuranceValue: 0m,
            additions: 0m,
            deductions: 0m,
            exchangeRate: 3.65m);

        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(3650m);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_TransactionValue_WithAdditionsAndDeductions()
    {
        // 500 + 100 + 25 + 75 - 50 = 650, rate=1
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 500m,
            freightValue: 100m,
            insuranceValue: 25m,
            additions: 75m,
            deductions: 50m,
            exchangeRate: 1m);

        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(650m);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_TransactionValue_NegativeCIF_ReturnsZero()
    {
        // Math.Max(0, negative) => 0
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 100m,
            freightValue: 0m,
            insuranceValue: 0m,
            additions: 0m,
            deductions: 500m,
            exchangeRate: 1m);

        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(0m);
    }

    // ── Zero / invalid exchange rates ─────────────────────────────────────────

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0)]
    [InlineData(-5)]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_ZeroOrNegativeExchangeRate_TreatedAsOne(decimal badRate)
    {
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 1000m,
            freightValue: 0m,
            insuranceValue: 0m,
            additions: 0m,
            deductions: 0m,
            exchangeRate: badRate);

        // exchange defaults to 1 => result = 1000
        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(1000m);
    }

    // ── Fallback (non-TransactionValue methods) ───────────────────────────────

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("IdenticalGoods")]
    [InlineData("SimilarGoods")]
    [InlineData("DeductiveValue")]
    [InlineData("ComputedValue")]
    [InlineData("FallbackMethod")]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_NonTransactionValueMethod_UsesInvoiceValueOnly(string method)
    {
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: method,
            invoiceValue: 800m,
            freightValue: 200m,   // ignored in fallback
            insuranceValue: 100m, // ignored in fallback
            additions: 50m,       // ignored in fallback
            deductions: 0m,
            exchangeRate: 2m);

        // fallback = invoiceValue * rate = 800 * 2 = 1600
        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(1600m);
    }

    // ── Edge: zero invoice ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void CalculateCustomsValue_ZeroInvoice_ReturnsZero()
    {
        var valuation = BuildValuation(
            method: "TransactionValue",
            invoiceValue: 0m,
            freightValue: 0m,
            insuranceValue: 0m,
            additions: 0m,
            deductions: 0m,
            exchangeRate: 3m);

        _policy.CalculateCustomsValue(valuation).Should().Be(0m);
    }

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static CustomsValuation BuildValuation(
        string method,
        decimal invoiceValue,
        decimal freightValue,
        decimal insuranceValue,
        decimal additions,
        decimal deductions,
        decimal exchangeRate) => new()
    {
        ValuationMethod = method,
        InvoiceValue    = invoiceValue,
        FreightValue    = freightValue,
        InsuranceValue  = insuranceValue,
        Additions       = additions,
        Deductions      = deductions,
        ExchangeRate    = exchangeRate,
        CurrencyCode    = "USD"
    };
}

/**
 * Integration Test: MongoDB Database Container
 */

import { MongoClient, Db } from 'mongodb';
import { getMongoClient, mongoDbName } from '../helpers/dbClient';

describe('MongoDB Integration Tests', () => {
  let client: MongoClient;
  let db: Db;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    client = getMongoClient();
    await client.connect();
    db = client.db(mongoDbName);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (client) {
      await client.close();
    }
  });

  test('should successfully connect to MongoDB container and perform ping command', async () => {
    const pingResult = await db.command({ ping: 1 });
    expect(pingResult.ok).toBe(1);
  });

  test('should perform CRUD operations on logistics telemetry collection', async () => {
    const collection = db.collection('audit_logs');
    await collection.deleteMany({}); // Reset

    // 1. Create / Insert document
    const testLog = {
      action: 'DECLARATION_SUBMITTED',
      declarationId: 'DEC-88912',
      operatorId: 'op-404',
      timestamp: new Date(),
      metadata: {
        ipAddress: '192.168.1.50',
        userAgent: 'JestTestRunner/1.0',
      },
    };

    const insertRes = await collection.insertOne(testLog);
    expect(insertRes.acknowledged).toBe(true);
    expect(insertRes.insertedId).toBeDefined();

    // 2. Read / Find document
    const found = await collection.findOne({ declarationId: 'DEC-88912' });
    expect(found).not.toBeNull();
    expect(found?.action).toBe('DECLARATION_SUBMITTED');
    expect(found?.metadata.ipAddress).toBe('192.168.1.50');

    // 3. Update document
    const updateRes = await collection.updateOne(
      { declarationId: 'DEC-88912' },
      { $set: { action: 'DECLARATION_VERIFIED', 'metadata.status': 'APPROVED' } }
    );
    expect(updateRes.modifiedCount).toBe(1);

    const updated = await collection.findOne({ declarationId: 'DEC-88912' });
    expect(updated?.action).toBe('DECLARATION_VERIFIED');
    expect(updated?.metadata.status).toBe('APPROVED');

    // 4. Delete document
    const deleteRes = await collection.deleteOne({ declarationId: 'DEC-88912' });
    expect(deleteRes.deletedCount).toBe(1);
  });

  test('should support creating compound indexes on document fields', async () => {
    const collection = db.collection('vessel_telemetry');
    
    // Create index
    const indexName = await collection.createIndex({ mmsi: 1, timestamp: -1 });
    expect(typeof indexName).toBe('string');

    // Verify index exists
    const indexes = await collection.indexes();
    const hasMmsiIndex = indexes.some((idx) => idx.name === indexName);
    expect(hasMmsiIndex).toBe(true);

    await collection.drop();
  });
});

<file path="tests/database/postgres.test.ts">
/**
 * Integration Test: PostgreSQL / PostGIS Database Container
 */

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { getPostgresPool } from '../helpers/dbClient';

describe('PostgreSQL / PostGIS Database Integration Tests', () => {
  let pool: Pool;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    pool = getPostgresPool();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (pool) {
      await pool.end();
    }
  });

  test('should successfully connect to PostgreSQL container and run SELECT 1', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      const res = await client.query('SELECT 1 AS connected, NOW() AS server_time');
      expect(res.rows).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(res.rows[0].connected).toBe(1);
      expect(res.rows[0].server_time).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  });

  test('should verify PostGIS spatial extension is available', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;');
      const res = await client.query('SELECT PostGIS_Full_Version()');
      expect(res.rows).toHaveLength(1);
      const versionStr = res.rows[0].postgis_full_version;
      expect(versionStr.toLowerCase()).toContain('postgis');
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  });

  test('should perform table DDL, insert spatial coordinates, and query distance using PostGIS', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      // 1. Create temporary test table
      await client.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_ports (
          id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
          name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
          location GEOMETRY(Point, 4326)
        );
      `);

      // Clear previous test records
      await client.query('TRUNCATE TABLE test_ports');

      // 2. Insert test ports using PostGIS ST_MakePoint (Longitude, Latitude)
      // Mogadishu Port: 45.3333 E, 2.0333 N
      // Berbera Port: 45.0167 E, 10.4333 N
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO test_ports (name, location) VALUES
        ('Mogadishu Port', ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(45.3333, 2.0333), 4326)),
        ('Berbera Port', ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(45.0167, 10.4333), 4326));
      `);

      // 3. Query ports count
      const countRes = await client.query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_ports');
      expect(parseInt(countRes.rows[0].count, 10)).toBe(2);

      // 4. Calculate spatial distance using PostGIS ST_DistanceSphere (in meters)
      const distRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT 
          p1.name AS from_port,
          p2.name AS to_port,
          ST_DistanceSphere(p1.location, p2.location) AS distance_meters
        FROM test_ports p1, test_ports p2
        WHERE p1.name = 'Mogadishu Port' AND p2.name = 'Berbera Port';
      `);

      expect(distRes.rows).toHaveLength(1);
      const distKm = distRes.rows[0].distance_meters / 1000;
      expect(distKm).toBeGreaterThan(900);
      expect(distKm).toBeLessThan(1000);

      // 5. Cleanup test table
      await client.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS test_ports');
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  });

  test('should handle database transactions correctly (BEGIN, ROLLBACK)', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_tx (id INT, val TEXT)');
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query("INSERT INTO test_tx VALUES (1, 'rollback_me')");
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');

      const res = await client.query('SELECT * FROM test_tx WHERE id = 1');
      expect(res.rows).toHaveLength(0);

      await client.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS test_tx');
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  });
});

<file path="tests/database/redis.test.ts">
/**
 * Integration Test: Redis Container
 */

import Redis from 'ioredis';
import { getRedisClient } from '../helpers/dbClient';

describe('Redis Integration Tests', () => {
  let client: Redis;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    client = getRedisClient();
    await client.connect();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (client) {
      await client.quit();
    }
  });

  test('should ping Redis and receive PONG', async () => {
    const response = await client.ping();
    expect(response).toBe('PONG');
  });

  test('should set and get a string key with TTL', async () => {
    const key = 'test:key';
    await client.set(key, 'value', 'EX', 2); // expires in 2 seconds
    const val = await client.get(key);
    expect(val).toBe('value');
    // wait 3 seconds to ensure expiration
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000));
    const expired = await client.get(key);
    expect(expired).toBeNull();
  });

  test('should work with hash structures for session data', async () => {
    const hashKey = 'session:123';
    await client.hset(hashKey, { userId: 'u-42', role: 'Importer', ttl: '3600' });
    const hash = await client.hgetall(hashKey);
    expect(hash).toMatchObject({ userId: 'u-42', role: 'Importer', ttl: '3600' });
    await client.del(hashKey);
  });

  test('should publish and receive a message via Pub/Sub', async () => {
    const channel = 'test:channel';
    const message = 'hello-world';
    const subscriber = new Redis();
    await subscriber.subscribe(channel);

    const promise = new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
      subscriber.on('message', (chan, msg) => {
        if (chan === channel) resolve(msg);
      });
    });

    await client.publish(channel, message);
    const received = await promise;
    expect(received).toBe(message);

    await subscriber.unsubscribe(channel);
    await subscriber.quit();
  });
});

              .WithErrorMessage("TenantId is required.");

        result.ShouldHaveValidationErrorFor(c => c.ApplicationReference);
    }

    [Fact]

    {
        var cmd = ValidCommand();
        cmd.CreatedBy = Guid.Empty;

        var result = _validator.TestValidate(cmd);
        result.ShouldHaveValidationErrorFor(c => c.CreatedBy);
    }

    public void Should_Fail_When_Type_IsOutOfRange()
    {
        var cmd = ValidCommand();

        var result = _validator.TestValidate(cmd);

    public void Should_Pass_For_All_Valid_EctnTypes(EctnType type)
    {
        var cmd = ValidCommand();
        cmd.Type = type;

        var result = _validator.TestValidate(cmd);
        result.ShouldNotHaveValidationErrorFor(c => c.Type);

<file path="tests/Ectn.UnitTests/Domain/EctnStateTransitionServiceTests.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using FluentAssertions;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;
using Ectn.Domain.Services;
using EctnEntity = Ectn.Domain.Entities.Ectn;

namespace Ectn.UnitTests.Domain;

public class EctnStateTransitionServiceTests
{
    private readonly EctnStateTransitionService _service = new();

    private static EctnEntity BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus status, bool withParty = true)
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = new EctnEntity(Guid.NewGuid(), "APP-TST-001", EctnType.Standard, actorId);

        if (withParty)
        {
            ectn.AddParty(new EctnParty { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), LegalName = "Test Shipper" });
        }

        switch (status)
        {
            case EctnStatus.Draft:
                break;
            case EctnStatus.Submitted:
                ectn.Submit(actorId);
                break;
            case EctnStatus.UnderReview:
                ectn.Submit(actorId);
                ectn.StartReview(actorId);
                break;
            case EctnStatus.Approved:
                ectn.Submit(actorId);
                ectn.Approve(actorId);
                break;
            case EctnStatus.Issued:
                ectn.Submit(actorId);
                ectn.Approve(actorId);
                ectn.Issue("ECTN-SVC-001", actorId);
                break;
            case EctnStatus.Rejected:
                ectn.Submit(actorId);
                ectn.Reject("Test rejection.", actorId);
                break;
            case EctnStatus.Cancelled:
                ectn.Cancel("Test cancellation.", actorId);
                break;
        }

        return ectn;
    }

    // ─── Submit Transition ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Pass_When_SubmittingDraft_WithParties()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Draft, withParty: true);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Submitted, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_SubmittingDraft_WithoutParties()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Draft, withParty: false);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Submitted, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("ECTN must have at least one party defined before submission.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_SubmittingNonDraft()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Submitted);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Submitted, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("ECTN must be in Draft state to be submitted.");
    }

    // ─── Approve Transition ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Pass_When_ApprovingSubmitted()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Submitted);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Approved, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Pass_When_ApprovingUnderReview()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.UnderReview);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Approved, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_ApprovingDraft()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Draft);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Approved, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");
    }

    // ─── Issue Transition ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Pass_When_IssuingApproved_WithEctnNumber()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Approved);
        ectn.AssignEctnNumber("ECTN-2026-SERVICE-001");
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Issued, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_IssuingApproved_WithoutEctnNumber()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Approved);
        // No EctnNumber assigned
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Issued, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("ECTN must have an official number assigned before issuance.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_IssuingDraft()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Draft);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Issued, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("ECTN must be Approved before it can be Issued.");
    }

    // ─── Reject Transition ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Pass_When_RejectingSubmitted()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Submitted);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Rejected, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().NotThrowAsync();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_RejectingIssuedEctn()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Issued);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Rejected, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ValidateTransition_Should_Throw_When_RejectingCancelledEctn()
    {
        var ectn = BuildEctnInStatus(EctnStatus.Cancelled);
        var act = async () => await _service.ValidateTransitionAsync(ectn, EctnStatus.Rejected, Guid.NewGuid());
        await act.Should().ThrowAsync<InvalidOperationException>()
                 .WithMessage("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
    }
}

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { MongoClient } from 'mongodb';
import Redis from 'ioredis';

export const postgresConfig = {
  host: process.env.POSTGRES_HOST || 'localhost',
  port: parseInt(process.env.POSTGRES_PORT || '5432', 10),
  user: process.env.POSTGRES_USER || 'postgres',
  password: process.env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD || 'Password123!',
  database: process.env.POSTGRES_DB || 'postgres',
};

export const mongoUrl = process.env.MONGO_URL || 'mongodb://localhost:27017';
export const mongoDbName = process.env.MONGO_DB_NAME || 'smart_trade_test';

export const redisConfig = {
  host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
  port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379', 10),
};

export function getPostgresPool(): Pool {
  return new Pool(postgresConfig);
}

export function getMongoClient(): MongoClient {
  return new MongoClient(mongoUrl);
}

export function getRedisClient(): Redis {
  return new Redis(redisConfig);
}

<file path="tests/Payment.UnitTests/Application/CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandlerTests.cs">
using Moq;
using FluentAssertions;
using FluentValidation;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;
using Xunit;

namespace Payment.UnitTests.Application;

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandlerTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IPaymentDbContext> _dbContextMock;
    private readonly CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler _handler;

    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandlerTests()
    {
        _dbContextMock = new Mock<IPaymentDbContext>();
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(1);

        _handler = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler(_dbContextMock.Object);
    }

    // ── Happy path ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_ReturnsNonEmptyGuid()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        var result = await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        result.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_AddsPaymentIntentToContext()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        _dbContextMock.Verify(x => x.AddPaymentIntent(It.IsAny<PaymentIntent>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_CallsSaveChanges()
    {
        var command = BuildCommand();

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        _dbContextMock.Verify(x => x.SaveChangesAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()), Times.Once);
    }

    // ── Customs integration: CustomsCaseId is stored ──────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_CustomsCommand_StoresCustomsCaseIdInIntent()
    {
        var customsCaseId = Guid.NewGuid();
        PaymentIntent? captured = null;

        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddPaymentIntent(It.IsAny<PaymentIntent>()))
            .Callback<PaymentIntent>(pi => captured = pi);

        var command = BuildCommand(customsCaseId: customsCaseId, sourceSystem: "Customs");

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured.Should().NotBeNull();
        captured!.CustomsCaseId.Should().Be(customsCaseId);
        captured.SourceSystem.Should().Be("Customs");
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_CustomsCommand_StoresAssessmentIdAsSourceReferenceId()
    {
        PaymentIntent? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddPaymentIntent(It.IsAny<PaymentIntent>()))
            .Callback<PaymentIntent>(pi => captured = pi);

        var command = BuildCommand(sourceAggregateId: "ASSESS-2026-001", sourceSystem: "Customs");

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured!.SourceReferenceId.Should().Be("ASSESS-2026-001");
    }

    // ── Money mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_ValidCommand_MapsAmountAndCurrencyToIntent()
    {
        PaymentIntent? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddPaymentIntent(It.IsAny<PaymentIntent>()))
            .Callback<PaymentIntent>(pi => captured = pi);

        var command = BuildCommand(amount: 12500m, currency: "USD");

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured!.AmountRequested.Should().Be(12500m);
        captured.CurrencyCode.Should().Be("USD");
    }

    // ── DueDate passthrough ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public async Task Handle_WithDueDate_PropagatesDueDateToIntent()
    {
        PaymentIntent? captured = null;
        _dbContextMock
            .Setup(x => x.AddPaymentIntent(It.IsAny<PaymentIntent>()))
            .Callback<PaymentIntent>(pi => captured = pi);

        var dueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(14);
        var command = BuildCommand(dueDate: dueDate);

        await _handler.Handle(command, CancellationToken.None);

        captured!.DueDate.Should().BeCloseTo(dueDate, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
    }

    // ── Validator ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_ValidCommand_PassesWithNoErrors()
    {
        var validator = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator();
        var result = validator.Validate(BuildCommand());
        result.IsValid.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_ZeroAmount_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand(amount: 0m);

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "Amount");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_EmptyTenantId_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.TenantId = Guid.Empty;

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "TenantId");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validator_EmptySourceSystem_FailsValidation()
    {
        var validator = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand();
        command.SourceSystem = "";

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "SourceSystem");
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("US")]      // too short
    [InlineData("USDD")]    // too long
    [InlineData("")]        // empty
    public void Validator_InvalidCurrencyCode_FailsValidation(string badCurrency)
    {
        var validator = new CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator();
        var command = BuildCommand(currency: badCurrency);

        var result = validator.Validate(command);

        result.IsValid.Should().BeFalse();
        result.Errors.Should().Contain(e => e.PropertyName == "Currency");
    }

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static CreatePaymentIntentCommand BuildCommand(
        decimal amount           = 5000m,
        string currency          = "USD",
        Guid? customsCaseId      = null,
        string sourceSystem      = "Customs",
        string sourceAggregateId = "ASSESS-001",
        DateTime? dueDate        = null) => new()
    {
        TenantId          = Guid.NewGuid(),
        ExternalReference = "PI-EXT-001",
        SourceSystem      = sourceSystem,
        SourceAggregateId = sourceAggregateId,
        CustomsCaseId     = customsCaseId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
        DeclarationNumber = "DECL-2026-001",
        ECTNNumber        = "ECTN-2026-001",
        Amount            = amount,
        Currency          = currency,
        DueDate           = dueDate
    };

using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;
using FluentAssertions;

namespace Payment.UnitTests.Domain;

public class PaymentIntentTests
{
    private static readonly Guid TenantId       = Guid.NewGuid();
    private static readonly Guid CustomsCaseId  = Guid.NewGuid();

    // ── Constructor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_ValidArguments_SetsPropertiesCorrectly()
    {
        var money = new Money(5000m, "USD");

            tenantId:          TenantId,
            intentReference:   "PI-REF-001",
            sourceSystem:      "Customs",
            sourceReferenceId: "ASSESS-001",
            customsCaseId:     CustomsCaseId,
            declarationNumber: "DECL-001",
            ectnNumber:        "ECTN-001",
            money:             money);

        intent.TenantId.Should().Be(TenantId);
        intent.IntentReference.Should().Be("PI-REF-001");
        intent.SourceSystem.Should().Be("Customs");
        intent.SourceReferenceId.Should().Be("ASSESS-001");
        intent.CustomsCaseId.Should().Be(CustomsCaseId);
        intent.DeclarationNumber.Should().Be("DECL-001");
        intent.ECTNNumber.Should().Be("ECTN-001");
        intent.AmountRequested.Should().Be(5000m);
        intent.CurrencyCode.Should().Be("USD");
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Created");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_DefaultStatus_IsCreated()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Created");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_WithDueDate_SetsDueDate()
    {
        var dueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(30);
        var intent = new PaymentIntent(
            TenantId, "REF", "Customs", "SRC", CustomsCaseId,
            "DECL", "ECTN", new Money(100m, "USD"), dueDate);

        intent.DueDate.Should().BeCloseTo(dueDate, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
    }

    // ── Process ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Process_FromCreated_SetsStatusToProcessing()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Process();
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Processing");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Process_FromRequiresPaymentMethod_SetsStatusToProcessing()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Status = "RequiresPaymentMethod";
        intent.Process();
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Processing");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Process_FromInvalidState_Throws()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Status = "Succeeded";

        var act = () => intent.Process();

        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("*Cannot process payment intent*");
    }

    // ── MarkSucceeded ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void MarkSucceeded_FromProcessing_SetsStatusToSucceeded()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Process();
        var tx = BuildTransaction(intent.Id);

        intent.MarkSucceeded(tx);

        intent.Status.Should().Be("Succeeded");
        intent.Transactions.Should().ContainSingle();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MarkSucceeded_AlreadySucceeded_IsIdempotent()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Process();
        intent.MarkSucceeded(BuildTransaction(intent.Id));

        // calling again should not throw
        var act = () => intent.MarkSucceeded(BuildTransaction(intent.Id));
        act.Should().NotThrow();
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Succeeded");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MarkSucceeded_FromCanceled_Throws()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Cancel();

        var act = () => intent.MarkSucceeded(BuildTransaction(intent.Id));

        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("*Cannot succeed a canceled*");
    }

    // ── MarkFailed ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void MarkFailed_SetsStatusToFailed()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Process();
        intent.MarkFailed("Gateway timeout");

        intent.Status.Should().Be("Failed");
    }

    // ── Cancel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_FromCreated_SetsStatusToCanceled()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Cancel();
        intent.Status.Should().Be("Canceled");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_FromSucceeded_Throws()
    {
        var intent = BuildIntent(1000m, "USD");
        intent.Process();
        intent.MarkSucceeded(BuildTransaction(intent.Id));

        var act = () => intent.Cancel();

        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("*Cannot cancel an already succeeded*");
    }

    // ── Customs <-> Payment link ──────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void PaymentIntent_LinkedToCustomsCase_StoresCorrectCaseId()
    {
        var caseId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var intent = new PaymentIntent(
            TenantId, "PI-2026-001", "Customs", "ASSESS-XYZ", caseId,
            "DECL-2026-001", "ECTN-2026-001", new Money(12500m, "USD"));

        intent.CustomsCaseId.Should().Be(caseId);
        intent.SourceSystem.Should().Be("Customs");
        intent.SourceReferenceId.Should().Be("ASSESS-XYZ");
    }

    // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static PaymentIntent BuildIntent(decimal amount, string currency)
        => new(TenantId, "PI-REF", "Customs", "ASSESS-001", CustomsCaseId,
               "DECL-001", "ECTN-001", new Money(amount, currency));

    private static PaymentTransaction BuildTransaction(Guid intentId)
        => new() { PaymentIntentId = intentId, Amount = 1000m, CurrencyCode = "USD" };
}

/**
 * Unit Tests: Auth Service Logic
 */

export interface UserSession {
  userId: string;
  username: string;
  roles: string[];
  tenantId: string;
  isMfaEnabled: boolean;
}

export class AuthService {
  private secretKey = 'super-secret-jwt-key';

  public validateEmail(email: string): boolean {
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    return emailRegex.test(email);
  }

  public validatePasswordStrength(password: string): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
    if (password.length < 8) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long' };
    }
    if (!/[A-Z]/.exec(password)) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Password must contain at least one uppercase letter' };
    }
    if (!/[0-9]/.exec(password)) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Password must contain at least one number' };
    }
    if (!/[!@#$%^&*]/.exec(password)) {
      return { valid: false, reason: 'Password must contain at least one special character' };
    }
    return { valid: true };
  }

  public hasPermission(user: UserSession, requiredRole: string): boolean {
    if (!user || !user.roles) return false;
    if (user.roles.includes('SuperAdmin')) return true;
    return user.roles.includes(requiredRole);
  }

  public generateSessionToken(user: UserSession): string {
    const payload = `${user.userId}:${user.tenantId}:${Date.now()}`;
    return Buffer.from(payload).toString('base64');
  }

  public parseSessionToken(token: string): { userId: string; tenantId: string; timestamp: number } | null {
    try {
      const decoded = Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
      const parts = decoded.split(':');
      if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
      return {
        userId: parts[0],
        tenantId: parts[1],
        timestamp: parseInt(parts[2], 10),
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

describe('AuthService Unit Tests', () => {
  let authService: AuthService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    authService = new AuthService();
  });

  describe('Email Validation', () => {
    test('should accept valid email addresses', () => {
      expect(authService.validateEmail('user@smarttrade.com')).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.validateEmail('admin.customs@port.gov.so')).toBe(true);
    });

    test('should reject invalid email addresses', () => {
      expect(authService.validateEmail('invalid-email')).toBe(false);
      expect(authService.validateEmail('admin@')).toBe(false);
      expect(authService.validateEmail('@domain.com')).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Password Strength Rules', () => {
    test('should pass strong passwords', () => {
      const res = authService.validatePasswordStrength('Password123!');
      expect(res.valid).toBe(true);
    });

    test('should reject short passwords', () => {
      const res = authService.validatePasswordStrength('Pass1!');
      expect(res.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(res.reason).toContain('8 characters');
    });

    test('should reject passwords without special characters', () => {
      const res = authService.validatePasswordStrength('Password12345');
      expect(res.valid).toBe(false);
      expect(res.reason).toContain('special character');
    });
  });

  describe('RBAC Permission Checks', () => {
    const adminUser: UserSession = {
      userId: 'u-101',
      username: 'admin',
      roles: ['CustomsOfficer'],
      tenantId: 't-somalia',
      isMfaEnabled: true,
    };

    const superAdmin: UserSession = {
      userId: 'u-999',
      username: 'root',
      roles: ['SuperAdmin'],
      tenantId: 't-global',
      isMfaEnabled: true,
    };

    test('should allow user with required role', () => {
      expect(authService.hasPermission(adminUser, 'CustomsOfficer')).toBe(true);
    });

    test('should deny user without required role', () => {
      expect(authService.hasPermission(adminUser, 'FinanceManager')).toBe(false);
    });

    test('should allow SuperAdmin all roles', () => {
      expect(authService.hasPermission(superAdmin, 'FinanceManager')).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.hasPermission(superAdmin, 'PortAuthority')).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('Session Token Generation & Parsing', () => {
    test('should generate and correctly parse session tokens', () => {
      const user: UserSession = {
        userId: 'usr-42',
        username: 'trader1',
        roles: ['Importer'],
        tenantId: 'tenant-mogadishu',
        isMfaEnabled: false,
      };

      const token = authService.generateSessionToken(user);
      expect(typeof token).toBe('string');
      expect(token.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);

      const parsed = authService.parseSessionToken(token);
      expect(parsed).not.toBeNull();
      expect(parsed?.userId).toBe('usr-42');
      expect(parsed?.tenantId).toBe('tenant-mogadishu');
      expect(parsed?.timestamp).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.now());
    });

    test('should return null for malformed tokens', () => {
      expect(authService.parseSessionToken('invalid-base64!!!')).toBeNull();
    });
  });
});

<file path="tests/unit/declaration.service.test.ts">
/**
 * Unit Tests: Customs Declaration & HS Code Logic
 */

export interface DeclarationItem {
  hsCode: string;
  description: string;
  quantity: number;
  unitPriceUsd: number;
  weightKg: number;
}

export interface TaxCalculationResult {
  totalFobUsd: number;
  importDutyUsd: number;
  vatUsd: number;
  totalTaxUsd: number;
}

export class DeclarationService {
  // Duty rates based on HS Code prefix
  private dutyRates: Record<string, number> = {
    '8703': 0.25, // Motor cars (25%)
    '8517': 0.05, // Smartphones / Telecoms (5%)
    '1006': 0.00, // Rice (Exempt 0%)
    '3004': 0.00, // Pharmaceuticals (Exempt 0%)
  };

  private standardVatRate = 0.15; // 15% VAT

  public validateHsCode(hsCode: string): boolean {
    const cleaned = hsCode.replace(/[\s.-]/g, '');
    return /^\d{6,10}$/.test(cleaned);
  }

  public calculateTaxes(items: DeclarationItem[]): TaxCalculationResult {
    let totalFobUsd = 0;
    let importDutyUsd = 0;

    for (const item of items) {
      const itemFob = item.quantity * item.unitPriceUsd;
      totalFobUsd += itemFob;

      const hsPrefix = item.hsCode.substring(0, 4);
      const dutyRate = this.dutyRates[hsPrefix] ?? 0.10; // Default 10% duty
      importDutyUsd += itemFob * dutyRate;
    }

    // VAT is calculated on (FOB + Duty)
    const vatUsd = (totalFobUsd + importDutyUsd) * this.standardVatRate;
    const totalTaxUsd = importDutyUsd + vatUsd;

    return {
      totalFobUsd: Math.round(totalFobUsd * 100) / 100,
      importDutyUsd: Math.round(importDutyUsd * 100) / 100,
      vatUsd: Math.round(vatUsd * 100) / 100,
      totalTaxUsd: Math.round(totalTaxUsd * 100) / 100,
    };
  }

  public getDeclarationStatus(
    isVerified: boolean,
    taxesPaid: boolean,
    hasInspectionFlags: boolean
  ): 'DRAFT' | 'PENDING_INSPECTION' | 'PENDING_PAYMENT' | 'CLEARED' | 'REJECTED' {
    if (hasInspectionFlags) return 'PENDING_INSPECTION';
    if (!isVerified) return 'DRAFT';
    if (!taxesPaid) return 'PENDING_PAYMENT';
    return 'CLEARED';
  }
}

describe('DeclarationService Unit Tests', () => {
  let declarationService: DeclarationService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    declarationService = new DeclarationService();
  });

  describe('HS Code Validation', () => {
    test('should validate valid HS codes', () => {
      expect(declarationService.validateHsCode('8703.23.00')).toBe(true);
      expect(declarationService.validateHsCode('8517620000')).toBe(true);
      expect(declarationService.validateHsCode('1006.30')).toBe(true);
    });

    test('should reject invalid HS codes', () => {
      expect(declarationService.validateHsCode('INVALID')).toBe(false);
      expect(declarationService.validateHsCode('123')).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('Tax & Duty Calculations', () => {
    test('should calculate duty and VAT for motor vehicles (8703)', () => {
      const items: DeclarationItem[] = [
        {
          hsCode: '87032300',
          description: 'Toyota Land Cruiser',
          quantity: 2,
          unitPriceUsd: 30000,
          weightKg: 4500,
        },
      ];

      const result = declarationService.calculateTaxes(items);
      expect(result.totalFobUsd).toBe(60000);
      expect(result.importDutyUsd).toBe(15000); // 25% of 60,000
      expect(result.vatUsd).toBe(11250); // 15% of (60,000 + 15,000)
      expect(result.totalTaxUsd).toBe(26250);
    });

    test('should handle duty-exempt agricultural items (Rice - 1006)', () => {
      const items: DeclarationItem[] = [
        {
          hsCode: '10063000',
          description: 'Basmati Rice 50kg Bags',
          quantity: 100,
          unitPriceUsd: 50,
          weightKg: 5000,
        },
      ];

      const result = declarationService.calculateTaxes(items);
      expect(result.totalFobUsd).toBe(5000);
      expect(result.importDutyUsd).toBe(0); // 0% duty
      expect(result.vatUsd).toBe(750); // 15% of 5,000
      expect(result.totalTaxUsd).toBe(750);
    });
  });

  describe('Declaration Status Workflow', () => {
    test('should require inspection if flagged', () => {
      const status = declarationService.getDeclarationStatus(true, true, true);
      expect(status).toBe('PENDING_INSPECTION');
    });

    test('should require payment if verified but unpaid', () => {
      const status = declarationService.getDeclarationStatus(true, false, false);
      expect(status).toBe('PENDING_PAYMENT');
    });

    test('should clear declaration when verified and paid', () => {
      const status = declarationService.getDeclarationStatus(true, true, false);
      expect(status).toBe('CLEARED');
    });
  });
});

<file path="tests/unit/payment.service.test.ts">
/**
 * Unit Tests: Payment Gateway & Currency Conversion Logic
 */

export interface PaymentRequest {
  declarationId: string;
  amountUsd: number;
  paymentMethod: 'CARD' | 'MOBILE_MONEY' | 'BANK_TRANSFER';
  currency: 'USD' | 'SOS' | 'EUR';
}

export interface PaymentResult {
  transactionId: string;
  amountUsd: number;
  convertedAmount: number;
  currency: string;
  processingFeeUsd: number;
  totalChargedUsd: number;
  status: 'SUCCESS' | 'PENDING' | 'FAILED';
}

export class PaymentService {
  private exchangeRates: Record<string, number> = {
    USD: 1.0,
    SOS: 26000.0, // 1 USD = 26,000 Somali Shilling
    EUR: 0.92,    // 1 USD = 0.92 EUR
  };

  private feePercentage: Record<string, number> = {
    CARD: 0.025,         // 2.5% fee
    MOBILE_MONEY: 0.01,  // 1.0% fee
    BANK_TRANSFER: 0.005 // 0.5% fee
  };

  public convertCurrency(amountUsd: number, targetCurrency: string): number {
    const rate = this.exchangeRates[targetCurrency];
    if (!rate) throw new Error(`Unsupported currency: ${targetCurrency}`);
    return Math.round(amountUsd * rate * 100) / 100;
  }

  public calculateProcessingFee(amountUsd: number, method: 'CARD' | 'MOBILE_MONEY' | 'BANK_TRANSFER'): number {
    const feeRate = this.feePercentage[method] ?? 0.02;
    return Math.round(amountUsd * feeRate * 100) / 100;
  }

  public processPayment(req: PaymentRequest): PaymentResult {
    if (req.amountUsd <= 0) {
      throw new Error('Payment amount must be greater than zero');
    }

    const fee = this.calculateProcessingFee(req.amountUsd, req.paymentMethod);
    const converted = this.convertCurrency(req.amountUsd, req.currency);
    const totalCharged = req.amountUsd + fee;

    return {
      transactionId: `TXN-${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`,
      amountUsd: req.amountUsd,
      convertedAmount: converted,
      currency: req.currency,
      processingFeeUsd: fee,
      totalChargedUsd: totalCharged,
      status: 'SUCCESS',
    };
  }
}

describe('PaymentService Unit Tests', () => {
  let paymentService: PaymentService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    paymentService = new PaymentService();
  });

  describe('Currency Conversion', () => {
    test('should convert USD to SOS accurately', () => {
      const converted = paymentService.convertCurrency(100, 'SOS');
      expect(converted).toBe(2600000);
    });

    test('should convert USD to EUR accurately', () => {
      const converted = paymentService.convertCurrency(100, 'EUR');
      expect(converted).toBe(92);
    });

    test('should throw error for unsupported currency', () => {
      expect(() => paymentService.convertCurrency(100, 'XYZ')).toThrow('Unsupported currency');
    });
  });

  describe('Processing Fee Calculation', () => {
    test('should calculate 2.5% fee for Credit Card payments', () => {
      const fee = paymentService.calculateProcessingFee(1000, 'CARD');
      expect(fee).toBe(25);
    });

    test('should calculate 1.0% fee for Mobile Money payments', () => {
      const fee = paymentService.calculateProcessingFee(1000, 'MOBILE_MONEY');
      expect(fee).toBe(10);
    });

    test('should calculate 0.5% fee for Bank Transfers', () => {
      const fee = paymentService.calculateProcessingFee(1000, 'BANK_TRANSFER');
      expect(fee).toBe(5);
    });
  });

  describe('Payment Processing Workflow', () => {
    test('should process payment and return successful transaction result', () => {
      const result = paymentService.processPayment({
        declarationId: 'DEC-2026-001',
        amountUsd: 500,
        paymentMethod: 'MOBILE_MONEY',
        currency: 'USD',
      });

      expect(result.status).toBe('SUCCESS');
      expect(result.transactionId).toMatch(/^TXN-\d{6}$/);
      expect(result.processingFeeUsd).toBe(5);
      expect(result.totalChargedUsd).toBe(505);
    });

    test('should reject payments with 0 or negative amount', () => {
      expect(() =>
        paymentService.processPayment({
          declarationId: 'DEC-2026-002',
          amountUsd: 0,
          paymentMethod: 'CARD',
          currency: 'USD',
        })
      ).toThrow('greater than zero');
    });
  });
});

<file path="tests/unit/vessel.service.test.ts">
/**
 * Unit Tests: AIS Vessel Tracking & Geofencing Logic
 */

export interface Coordinates {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
}

export interface VesselPosition {
  mmsi: string;
  name: string;
  speedKnots: number;
  coords: Coordinates;
  timestamp: Date;
}

export class VesselService {
  /**
   * Calculate distance between two coordinates in nautical miles using Haversine formula
   */
  public calculateDistanceNauticalMiles(c1: Coordinates, c2: Coordinates): number {
    const R = 3440.065; // Earth radius in nautical miles
    const dLat = this.toRadians(c2.latitude - c1.latitude);
    const dLon = this.toRadians(c2.longitude - c1.longitude);

    const a =
      Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
      Math.cos(this.toRadians(c1.latitude)) *
        Math.cos(this.toRadians(c2.latitude)) *
        Math.sin(dLon / 2) *
        Math.sin(dLon / 2);

    const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
    return Math.round(R * c * 100) / 100;
  }

  private toRadians(degrees: number): number {
    return (degrees * Math.PI) / 180;
  }

  /**
   * Estimate Time of Arrival (ETA) in hours based on remaining distance and current speed
   */
  public estimateEtaHours(distanceNauticalMiles: number, speedKnots: number): number | null {
    if (speedKnots <= 0.5) return null; // Vessel stationary
    return Math.round((distanceNauticalMiles / speedKnots) * 10) / 10;
  }

  /**
   * Check if vessel is inside port geofence radius (nautical miles)
   */
  public isInsidePortGeofence(vesselCoords: Coordinates, portCoords: Coordinates, radiusNm: number = 5.0): boolean {
    const dist = this.calculateDistanceNauticalMiles(vesselCoords, portCoords);
    return dist <= radiusNm;
  }

  /**
   * Detect speed anomalies (e.g. speeding in port zone)
   */
  public isSpeedingInPortZone(speedKnots: number, inPortZone: boolean): boolean {
    const PORT_SPEED_LIMIT_KNOTS = 6.0;
    return inPortZone && speedKnots > PORT_SPEED_LIMIT_KNOTS;
  }
}

describe('VesselService Unit Tests', () => {
  let vesselService: VesselService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vesselService = new VesselService();
  });

  const mogadishuPort: Coordinates = { latitude: 2.0333, longitude: 45.3333 };

  describe('Haversine Distance Calculations', () => {
    test('should calculate distance 0 for identical coordinates', () => {
      const dist = vesselService.calculateDistanceNauticalMiles(mogadishuPort, mogadishuPort);
      expect(dist).toBe(0);
    });

    test('should calculate correct distance between Mogadishu and Berbera ports', () => {
      const berberaPort: Coordinates = { latitude: 10.4333, longitude: 45.0167 };
      const dist = vesselService.calculateDistanceNauticalMiles(mogadishuPort, berberaPort);
      expect(dist).toBeGreaterThan(500);
      expect(dist).toBeLessThan(520);
    });
  });

  describe('ETA Estimation', () => {
    test('should estimate correct ETA hours for moving vessel', () => {
      // 100 nautical miles at 10 knots = 10 hours
      const eta = vesselService.estimateEtaHours(100, 10);
      expect(eta).toBe(10);
    });

    test('should return null for stationary or anchored vessel', () => {
      const eta = vesselService.estimateEtaHours(100, 0.2);
      expect(eta).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('Port Geofence & Speed Anomalies', () => {
    test('should detect vessel inside port geofence (3 nautical miles away)', () => {
      const nearbyVessel: Coordinates = { latitude: 2.05, longitude: 45.34 };
      const isInside = vesselService.isInsidePortGeofence(nearbyVessel, mogadishuPort, 5.0);
      expect(isInside).toBe(true);
    });

    test('should detect vessel outside port geofence (20 nautical miles away)', () => {
      const distantVessel: Coordinates = { latitude: 2.30, longitude: 45.50 };
      const isInside = vesselService.isInsidePortGeofence(distantVessel, mogadishuPort, 5.0);
      expect(isInside).toBe(false);
    });

    test('should flag vessel speeding over 6 knots inside port zone', () => {
      expect(vesselService.isSpeedingInPortZone(12.5, true)).toBe(true);
      expect(vesselService.isSpeedingInPortZone(4.5, true)).toBe(false);
      expect(vesselService.isSpeedingInPortZone(15.0, false)).toBe(false); // Open sea
    });
  });
});

<file path="apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx">
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AuthState {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  accessToken: string | null;
  tenantCode: string | null;
  permissions: string[];
}

interface AuthContextType extends AuthState {
  login: (token: string, tenant: string, perms: string[]) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  hasPermission: (permission: string) => boolean;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [authState, setAuthState] = useState<AuthState>({
    isAuthenticated: false,
    accessToken: null,
    tenantCode: null,
    permissions: [],
  });

  const login = (token: string, tenant: string, perms: string[]) => {
    // In a real app, securely store the token (e.g. secure HTTP-only cookies preferred, 
    // or memory + refresh token rotation)
    setAuthState({
      isAuthenticated: true,
      accessToken: token,
      tenantCode: tenant,
      permissions: perms,
    });
  };

  const logout = () => {
    setAuthState({
      isAuthenticated: false,
      accessToken: null,
      tenantCode: null,
      permissions: [],
    });
  };

  const hasPermission = (permission: string) => {
    return authState.permissions.includes(permission);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ ...authState, login, logout, hasPermission }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

<file path="building-blocks/persistence/HealthChecks/HealthCheckExtensions.cs">
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Persistence.HealthChecks;

public static class HealthCheckExtensions
{
    public static IHealthChecksBuilder AddDatabaseHealthChecks(
        this IServiceCollection services, 
        string postgresConnectionString, 
        string mongoConnectionString, 
        string redisConnectionString)
    {
        var builder = services.AddHealthChecks();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(postgresConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.Npgsql
            builder.AddNpgSql(
                postgresConnectionString,
                name: "postgresql",
                tags: new[] { "db", "sql", "ready" });
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(mongoConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.MongoDb
            builder.AddMongoDb(
                mongoConnectionString,
                name: "mongodb",
                tags: new[] { "db", "nosql", "ready" });
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(redisConnectionString))
        {
            // Requires: AspNetCore.HealthChecks.Redis
            builder.AddRedis(
                redisConnectionString,
                name: "redis",
                tags: new[] { "cache", "ready" });
        }

        return builder;
    }
}
