<file path="services/declaration/Declaration.Infrastructure/Persistence/DeclarationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Ensure SmartDbContext is accessible

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class DeclarationDbContext : SmartDbContext
{
    public DeclarationDbContext(DbContextOptions<DeclarationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<CustomsDeclaration> CustomsDeclarations => Set<CustomsDeclaration>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationVersion> DeclarationVersions => Set<DeclarationVersion>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationReference> DeclarationReferences => Set<DeclarationReference>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationParty> DeclarationParties => Set<DeclarationParty>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationPartyRole> DeclarationPartyRoles => Set<DeclarationPartyRole>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationCargo> DeclarationCargos => Set<DeclarationCargo>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationCargoItem> DeclarationCargoItems => Set<DeclarationCargoItem>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationContainer> DeclarationContainers => Set<DeclarationContainer>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationTransport> DeclarationTransports => Set<DeclarationTransport>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationRoute> DeclarationRoutes => Set<DeclarationRoute>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationDocument> DeclarationDocuments => Set<DeclarationDocument>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationDocumentVersion> DeclarationDocumentVersions => Set<DeclarationDocumentVersion>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationValidation> DeclarationValidations => Set<DeclarationValidation>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationAmendment> DeclarationAmendments => Set<DeclarationAmendment>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationSubmission> DeclarationSubmissions => Set<DeclarationSubmission>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationDecision> DeclarationDecisions => Set<DeclarationDecision>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationStatusHistory> DeclarationStatusHistories => Set<DeclarationStatusHistory>();
    
    public DbSet<DeclarationExternalReference> DeclarationExternalReferences => Set<DeclarationExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationIntegrationRecord> DeclarationIntegrationRecords => Set<DeclarationIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<DeclarationAuditEntry> DeclarationAuditEntries => Set<DeclarationAuditEntry>();
    
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core Aggregate
        builder.Entity<CustomsDeclaration>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.DeclarationNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(d => d.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.Status });
            e.HasIndex(d => new { d.TenantId, d.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(d => d.CurrentVersionNumber);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Restrict Cascade Delete
            e.HasMany(d => d.Versions).WithOne(v => v.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Validations).WithOne(v => v.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Submissions).WithOne(s => s.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(s => s.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Decisions).WithOne(dec => dec.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(dec => dec.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Amendments).WithOne(a => a.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(a => a.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.StatusHistories).WithOne(sh => sh.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(sh => sh.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(d => d.References).WithOne(r => r.CustomsDeclaration).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Declaration Version
        builder.Entity<DeclarationVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(v => new { v.DeclarationId, v.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(v => v.VersionStatus);
            e.Property(v => v.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.Property(v => v.TotalDeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.TotalGrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(v => v.TotalNetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            
            e.HasMany(v => v.Parties).WithOne(p => p.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(p => p.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Cargos).WithOne(c => c.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(c => c.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Containers).WithOne(c => c.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(c => c.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Transports).WithOne(t => t.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(t => t.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Routes).WithOne(r => r.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(v => v.Documents).WithOne(d => d.DeclarationVersion).HasForeignKey(d => d.DeclarationVersionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // References
        builder.Entity<DeclarationReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.DeclarationId, r.ReferenceType, r.NormalizedValue });
            e.HasIndex(r => r.TenantId);
        });

        // Cargo
        builder.Entity<DeclarationCargo>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CommodityCode);
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.Volume).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(c => c.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            
            e.HasMany(c => c.Items).WithOne(i => i.DeclarationCargo).HasForeignKey(i => i.DeclarationCargoId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo Item
        builder.Entity<DeclarationCargoItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.DeclarationCargoId, i.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(i => i.HsCodeDeclared);
            e.HasIndex(i => i.CommodityCode);
            e.HasIndex(i => i.CountryOfOrigin);
            
            e.Property(i => i.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalValue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Container
        builder.Entity<DeclarationContainer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => new { c.DeclarationVersionId, c.NormalizedContainerNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Party
        builder.Entity<DeclarationParty>(e =>
        {
            e.HasMany(p => p.Roles).WithOne(r => r.DeclarationParty).HasForeignKey(r => r.DeclarationPartyId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Document
        builder.Entity<DeclarationDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => d.DocumentType);
            e.HasIndex(d => d.Status);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(d => d.DocumentVersions).WithOne(v => v.DeclarationDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.DeclarationDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Submissions
        builder.Entity<DeclarationSubmission>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => s.SubmissionReference);
            e.HasIndex(s => s.SubmittedAtUtc);
        });

        // Amendments
        builder.Entity<DeclarationAmendment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(a => a.Status);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.RequestedAtUtc);
            e.Property(a => a.ChangeSummaryJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Validation
        builder.Entity<DeclarationValidation>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(v => v.DetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Audit
        builder.Entity<DeclarationAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // External Reference
        builder.Entity<DeclarationExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(er => new { er.ExternalSystem, er.ExternalReference });
        });

        // Idempotency
        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Domain.Entities;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Declaration.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Repositories;

public class CustomsDeclarationRepository : ICustomsDeclarationRepository
{
    private readonly DeclarationDbContext _context;

    public CustomsDeclarationRepository(DeclarationDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAsync(Guid id)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations.FindAsync(id);
    }

    public async Task<CustomsDeclaration> GetByIdAndTenantAsync(Guid id, Guid tenantId)
    {
        return await _context.CustomsDeclarations
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(d => d.Id == id && d.TenantId == tenantId);
    }

    public async Task AddAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        await _context.CustomsDeclarations.AddAsync(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    public async Task UpdateAsync(CustomsDeclaration declaration)
    {
        _context.CustomsDeclarations.Update(declaration);
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
    }
}

using System;

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Declaration.Application.Interfaces;
using Polly;
using Polly.CircuitBreaker;
using Polly.Retry;

namespace Declaration.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnServiceClient : IEctnServiceClient
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly AsyncRetryPolicy<HttpResponseMessage> _retryPolicy;

    public EctnServiceClient(HttpClient httpClient)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        
        // Resilience policies (Rule 63)
        _retryPolicy = Policy
            .HandleResult<HttpResponseMessage>(r => !r.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retryAttempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt)));
    }

    public async Task<bool> ValidateEctnAsync(string ectnReference, Guid tenantId)
    {
        // In a real implementation, this would make an actual HTTP call to the ECTN Service.
        // It should NOT access the ECTN database directly (Rule 11).
        
        // Dummy implementation for now:
        return await Task.FromResult(true); 
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Controllers/EctnController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Application.Commands;

namespace Ectn.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[Authorize] // Requires JWT from Phase 02
public class EctnController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public EctnController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.create")] // Requires explicit permission
    public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromBody] CreateEctnCommand command)
    {
        // Security Check: Ensure client cannot inject a different TenantId
        // The TenantId should be extracted from the authenticated user's JWT claims
        var tenantIdClaim = User.FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            command.TenantId = tenantId;
        }
        else
        {
            return Forbid("Tenant ID is missing from the authentication context.");
        }

        var actorIdClaim = User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(actorIdClaim, out var actorId))
        {
            command.CreatedBy = actorId;
        }

        var ectnId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(Get), new { id = ectnId }, new { Id = ectnId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Get(Guid id)
    {
        // Implement GetQuery
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Draft" });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/submit")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.submit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Submit(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute SubmitEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN submitted successfully." });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/approve")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.approve")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Approve(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute ApproveEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN approved successfully." });
    }

    [HttpPost("{id}/issue")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "ectn.issue")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Issue(Guid id)
    {
        // Execute IssueEctnCommand
        return Ok(new { Message = "ECTN issued successfully." });
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Api/Program.cs">
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.Text;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen();

// Configure MediatR (CQRS)
builder.Services.AddMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(Ectn.Application.Commands.CreateEctnCommand).Assembly));

// Configure Database
builder.Services.AddDbContext<EctnDbContext>(options =>
    options.UseNpgsql(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection")));

// Configure Authentication (Symmetric Key matches Phase 02 for dev, Vault for prod)
var secretKey = builder.Configuration["Jwt:Secret"] ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT Secret is missing from production configuration.");
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    .AddJwtBearer(options =>
    {
        options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
        {
            ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
            IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secretKey)),
            ValidateIssuer = false,
            ValidateAudience = false,
            ValidateLifetime = true
        };
    });

// Configure Permission-Based Authorization
builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
{
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.create", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.create"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.read", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.read"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.submit", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.submit"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.approve", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.approve"));
    options.AddPolicy("ectn.issue", policy => policy.RequireClaim("permissions", "ectn.issue"));
});

var app = builder.Build();

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.
if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseSwagger();
    app.UseSwaggerUI();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();

app.Run();
</file>

using System;
using MediatR;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Application.Commands;

public class CreateEctnCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ApplicationReference { get; set; }
    public EctnType Type { get; set; }
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
}

public class CreateEctnCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateEctnCommand, Guid>
{
    // Normally injected via DI: IEctnRepository, IUnitOfWork
    
    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateEctnCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Validate (FluentValidation would intercept before this point)
        
        // 2. Map command to Domain Entity
        var ectn = new Domain.Entities.Ectn(
            request.TenantId,
            request.ApplicationReference,
            request.Type,
            request.CreatedBy
        );

        // 3. Save via Repository
        // await _repository.AddAsync(ectn, cancellationToken);
        // await _unitOfWork.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);

        // 4. Return the new ID
        return ectn.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Domain/Services/EctnStateTransitionService.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;

namespace Ectn.Domain.Services;

public interface IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId);
}

public class EctnStateTransitionService : IEctnStateTransitionService
{
    public Task ValidateTransitionAsync(Domain.Entities.Ectn ectn, EctnStatus targetStatus, Guid actorId)
    {
        // Enforce strict Domain Invariants (Rule 83)
        switch (targetStatus)
        {
            case EctnStatus.Submitted:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Draft)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be in Draft state to be submitted.");
                if (ectn.Parties.Count == 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have at least one party defined before submission.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Approved:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.UnderReview && ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Submitted)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");
                break;
                
            case EctnStatus.Issued:
                if (ectn.Status != EctnStatus.Approved)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must be Approved before it can be Issued.");
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ectn.EctnNumber))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("ECTN must have an official number assigned before issuance.");
                break;

            case EctnStatus.Rejected:
                if (ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Issued || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Expired || ectn.Status == EctnStatus.Cancelled)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
                break;
        }

        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

public class EctnDbContext : SmartDbContext
{
    public EctnDbContext(DbContextOptions<EctnDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    public DbSet<EctnApplication> EctnApplications => Set<EctnApplication>();
    public DbSet<EctnCertificate> EctnCertificates => Set<EctnCertificate>();
    public DbSet<EctnReference> EctnReferences => Set<EctnReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnParty> EctnParties => Set<EctnParty>();
    public DbSet<EctnPartyRole> EctnPartyRoles => Set<EctnPartyRole>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnShipment> EctnShipments => Set<EctnShipment>();
    public DbSet<EctnCargo> EctnCargos => Set<EctnCargo>();
    public DbSet<EctnCargoItem> EctnCargoItems => Set<EctnCargoItem>();
    public DbSet<EctnContainer> EctnContainers => Set<EctnContainer>();
    public DbSet<EctnBillOfLading> EctnBillOfLadings => Set<EctnBillOfLading>();
    public DbSet<EctnVesselReference> EctnVesselReferences => Set<EctnVesselReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnVoyageReference> EctnVoyageReferences => Set<EctnVoyageReference>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnValidation> EctnValidations => Set<EctnValidation>();
    public DbSet<EctnReview> EctnReviews => Set<EctnReview>();
    public DbSet<EctnDecision> EctnDecisions => Set<EctnDecision>();
    public DbSet<EctnAmendment> EctnAmendments => Set<EctnAmendment>();
    public DbSet<EctnStatusHistory> EctnStatusHistories => Set<EctnStatusHistory>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnDocument> EctnDocuments => Set<EctnDocument>();
    public DbSet<EctnDocumentVersion> EctnDocumentVersions => Set<EctnDocumentVersion>();
    public DbSet<EctnDocumentVerification> EctnDocumentVerifications => Set<EctnDocumentVerification>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnQrCode> EctnQrCodes => Set<EctnQrCode>();
    public DbSet<EctnVerification> EctnVerifications => Set<EctnVerification>();
    
    public DbSet<EctnExternalReference> EctnExternalReferences => Set<EctnExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<EctnIntegrationRecord> EctnIntegrationRecords => Set<EctnIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<EctnAuditEntry> EctnAuditEntries => Set<EctnAuditEntry>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core Aggregate
        builder.Entity<EctnApplication>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(a => new { a.TenantId, a.ApplicationNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(a => a.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.Status);
            e.HasIndex(a => a.CreatedAtUtc);
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Restrict Cascade Delete - historical ECTNs shouldn't be deleted implicitly
            e.HasMany(a => a.Certificates).WithOne(c => c.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.Shipments).WithOne(s => s.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(s => s.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.PartyRoles).WithOne(pr => pr.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(pr => pr.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.Documents).WithOne(d => d.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(d => d.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(a => a.StatusHistories).WithOne(sh => sh.EctnApplication).HasForeignKey(sh => sh.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Certificate
        builder.Entity<EctnCertificate>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.EctnNumber).IsUnique(); // Policy rule
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CertificateNumber).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(c => c.Status);
            e.HasIndex(c => c.ExpiresAtUtc);
        });

        // References
        builder.Entity<EctnReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.TenantId, r.ReferenceType, r.NormalizedValue }).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne(r => r.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(r => r.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Party Roles
        builder.Entity<EctnPartyRole>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pr => new { pr.EctnApplicationId, pr.EctnPartyId, pr.RoleType }).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne(pr => pr.EctnParty).WithMany().HasForeignKey(pr => pr.EctnPartyId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Shipment
        builder.Entity<EctnShipment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => s.ShipmentReference);
            
            // Numeric configurations
            e.Property(s => s.TotalGrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.TotalNetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.TotalVolume).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.FreightValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(s => s.InsuranceValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            
            e.HasMany(s => s.Cargos).WithOne(c => c.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.Containers).WithOne(c => c.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(c => c.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.BillOfLadings).WithOne(b => b.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(b => b.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.VesselReferences).WithOne(v => v.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(s => s.VoyageReferences).WithOne(v => v.EctnShipment).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnShipmentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo
        builder.Entity<EctnCargo>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.HsCode);
            e.HasIndex(c => c.CommodityCode);
            
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.Volume).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(c => c.DeclaredValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            
            e.HasMany(c => c.Items).WithOne(i => i.EctnCargo).HasForeignKey(i => i.EctnCargoId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Cargo Item
        builder.Entity<EctnCargoItem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.EctnCargoId, i.LineNumber }).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(i => i.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(18,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.NetWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalValue).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        });

        // Container
        builder.Entity<EctnContainer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(c => c.NormalizedContainerNumber);
            e.Property(c => c.GrossWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(18,2)");
        });

        // Bill of Lading
        builder.Entity<EctnBillOfLading>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(b => new { b.EctnShipmentId, b.NormalizedBolNumber }).IsUnique();
        });

        // Validation
        builder.Entity<EctnValidation>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(v => v.ValidationDetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.HasOne(v => v.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Amendment
        builder.Entity<EctnAmendment>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.ChangeSummaryJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.Version).IsRowVersion();
            e.HasOne(a => a.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(a => a.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Documents
        builder.Entity<EctnDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(d => d.Status);
            e.HasIndex(d => d.DocumentType);
            e.Property(d => d.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(d => d.DocumentVersions).WithOne(v => v.EctnDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasMany(d => d.Verifications).WithOne(v => v.EctnDocument).HasForeignKey(v => v.EctnDocumentId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Audit & Integration
        builder.Entity<EctnAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(a => a.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(a => a.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        builder.Entity<EctnExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(er => new { er.ExternalSystem, er.ExternalReference });
            e.HasIndex(er => er.ExternalStatus);
            e.HasOne(er => er.EctnApplication).WithMany().HasForeignKey(er => er.EctnApplicationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/ectn/Ectn.Infrastructure/Services/EctnNumberGenerator.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Ectn.Application.Interfaces;
using Ectn.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Ectn.Infrastructure.Services;

public class EctnNumberGenerator : IEctnNumberGenerator
{
    private readonly EctnDbContext _dbContext;

    public EctnNumberGenerator(EctnDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<string> GenerateOfficialNumberAsync(Guid tenantId, string portOfLoading, DateTime issueDate)
    {
        // Enterprise ECTN number generation: ECTN-{YEAR}-{PORT}-{SEQUENCE}
        // Utilizing a database sequence for strict transaction-safe collision prevention
        var year = issueDate.Year;
        var portCode = portOfLoading?.Substring(0, Math.Min(3, portOfLoading.Length)).ToUpperInvariant() ?? "GEN";
        
        long sequenceValue;
        using (var command = _dbContext.Database.GetDbConnection().CreateCommand())
        {
            command.CommandText = $"SELECT nextval('ectn_seq_{tenantId:N}')";
            _dbContext.Database.OpenConnection();
            var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync();
            sequenceValue = result != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt64(result) : throw new Exception("Sequence generation failed");
        }

        return $"ECTN-{year}-{portCode}-{sequenceValue}";
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Api/Controllers/DispatchesController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Fleet.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/dispatches")]
[Authorize]
public class DispatchesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public DispatchesController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateDispatch([FromBody] CreateDispatchCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var dispatchId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetDispatch), new { id = dispatchId }, new { DispatchId = dispatchId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "fleet.dispatch.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDispatch(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Draft" });
    }
}

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Application/Commands/CreateDispatchCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace Fleet.Application.Commands;

public class CreateDispatchCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid FleetCompanyId { get; set; }
    public Guid VehicleId { get; set; }
    public Guid DriverId { get; set; }
    public string CargoReference { get; set; }
    public string CustomsCaseReference { get; set; }
}

public class CreateDispatchCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateDispatchCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly FleetDbContext _context;

    public CreateDispatchCommandHandler(FleetDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateDispatchCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var dispatchNumber = $"DSP-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var dispatch = new DispatchOrder(
            request.TenantId,
            dispatchNumber,
            request.FleetCompanyId,
            request.VehicleId,
            request.DriverId,
            request.CargoReference,
            request.CustomsCaseReference
        );

        _context.DispatchOrders.Add(dispatch);
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return dispatch.Id;
    }
}

namespace Fleet.Domain.Entities;

public class Driver
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

<file path="services/fleet/Fleet.Infrastructure/Persistence/FleetDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Fleet.Domain.Entities;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence;

namespace Fleet.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class FleetDbContext : SmartDbContext
{
    public FleetDbContext(DbContextOptions<FleetDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // Core
    public DbSet<FleetCompany> FleetCompanies => Set<FleetCompany>();
    public DbSet<Vehicle> Vehicles => Set<Vehicle>();
    public DbSet<Truck> Trucks => Set<Truck>();
    public DbSet<Trailer> Trailers => Set<Trailer>();
    public DbSet<Driver> Drivers => Set<Driver>();

    // Compliance & Licensing
    public DbSet<VehicleRegistration> Registrations => Set<VehicleRegistration>();
    public DbSet<VehicleCompliance> VehicleCompliances => Set<VehicleCompliance>();
    public DbSet<DriverLicense> Licenses => Set<DriverLicense>();
    public DbSet<DriverQualification> Qualifications => Set<DriverQualification>();
    public DbSet<DriverCompliance> DriverCompliances => Set<DriverCompliance>();
    public DbSet<VehicleInspection> Inspections => Set<VehicleInspection>();
    public DbSet<DriverVerification> Verifications => Set<DriverVerification>();

    // Documents & Capabilities
    public DbSet<VehicleDocument> VehicleDocuments => Set<VehicleDocument>();
    public DbSet<DriverDocument> DriverDocuments => Set<DriverDocument>();
    public DbSet<FleetDocumentVersion> DocumentVersions => Set<FleetDocumentVersion>();
    public DbSet<VehicleCapability> VehicleCapabilities => Set<VehicleCapability>();
    public DbSet<DriverCapability> DriverCapabilities => Set<DriverCapability>();
    public DbSet<VehicleMaintenanceRecord> MaintenanceRecords => Set<VehicleMaintenanceRecord>();

    // Assignments & Dispatch
    public DbSet<VehicleAssignment> VehicleAssignments => Set<VehicleAssignment>();
    public DbSet<DriverAssignment> DriverAssignments => Set<DriverAssignment>();
    public DbSet<TrailerAssignment> TrailerAssignments => Set<TrailerAssignment>();
    public DbSet<DispatchOrder> DispatchOrders => Set<DispatchOrder>();
    public DbSet<DispatchRequirement> DispatchRequirements => Set<DispatchRequirement>();

    // History & Holds
    public DbSet<FleetHold> Holds => Set<FleetHold>();
    public DbSet<DispatchStatusHistory> DispatchStatusHistories => Set<DispatchStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<VehicleStatusHistory> VehicleStatusHistories => Set<VehicleStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<DriverStatusHistory> DriverStatusHistories => Set<DriverStatusHistory>();
    public DbSet<AssignmentHistory> AssignmentHistories => Set<AssignmentHistory>();

    // Integration & Audit
    public DbSet<FleetExternalReference> ExternalReferences => Set<FleetExternalReference>();
    public DbSet<FleetIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords => Set<FleetIntegrationRecord>();
    public DbSet<FleetAuditEntry> AuditEntries => Set<FleetAuditEntry>();
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Core
        builder.Entity<FleetCompany>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.OrganizationId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCode }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Vehicle>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedLicensePlate }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.VIN);
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();

            e.HasOne(x => x.Truck)
             .WithOne(t => t.Vehicle)
             .HasForeignKey<Truck>(t => t.VehicleId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<Truck>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.GrossVehicleWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.TareWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadCapacity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Trailer>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.TrailerReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NormalizedLicensePlate }).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(x => x.GrossVehicleWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.TareWeight).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadCapacity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<Driver>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DriverReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserId }); // UserId may be null for offline drivers
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Assignments (Concurrency protected)
        builder.Entity<VehicleAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<DriverAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<TrailerAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TrailerId, x.Status, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Dispatch
        builder.Entity<DispatchOrder>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.FleetCompanyId, x.DispatchReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleId, x.DriverId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(x => x.Requirements)
             .WithOne(r => r.DispatchOrder)
             .HasForeignKey(r => r.DispatchOrderId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
             
            e.HasMany(x => x.DriverAssignments).WithOne(a => a.DispatchOrder).HasForeignKey(a => a.DispatchOrderId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasMany(x => x.TrailerAssignments).WithOne(a => a.DispatchOrder).HasForeignKey(a => a.DispatchOrderId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Compliance & Inspections
        builder.Entity<VehicleCompliance>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.VehicleId, x.ExpiryDateUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        builder.Entity<DriverCompliance>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.DriverId, x.ExpiryDateUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
        
        // Documents
        builder.Entity<VehicleDocument>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleId, x.DocumentType, x.Status });
        });

        // Integration / Idempotency / Audit / Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<FleetAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
        });

        builder.Entity<AssignmentHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(x => x.PreviousValueJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.NewValueJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        builder.Entity<FleetHold>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId, x.Status });
        });
        
        builder.Entity<FleetExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExternalSystem, x.ExternalReference });
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Api/Controllers/TelemetryIngestionController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace GpsTelematics.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/gps/ingest")]
public class TelemetryIngestionController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public TelemetryIngestionController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    // Note: In production, this would use a specialized scheme for Device Token / Client Certificate auth
    // rather than standard user JWTs. We simulate standard auth here for demonstration.
    [Authorize] 
    public async Task<IActionResult> IngestTelemetry([FromBody] IngestTelemetryCommand command)
    {
        // For security, TenantId and DeviceId should be extracted from the authenticated device token
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }
        
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "deviceId"))
        {
            command.DeviceId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("deviceId").Value);
        }

        var positionId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Accepted(new { PositionId = positionId, Status = "Processed" });
    }
}

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Application/Commands/IngestTelemetryCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;
using GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

namespace GpsTelematics.Application.Commands;

public class IngestTelemetryCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid DeviceId { get; set; }
    public double Latitude { get; set; }
    public double Longitude { get; set; }
    public double Speed { get; set; }
    public double Heading { get; set; }
    public DateTime RecordedAt { get; set; }
    public long SequenceNumber { get; set; }
    // VehicleId is resolved during processing if device is actively assigned
    public Guid? VehicleId { get; set; } 
}

public class IngestTelemetryCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<IngestTelemetryCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly GpsDbContext _context;

    public IngestTelemetryCommandHandler(GpsDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(IngestTelemetryCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var position = new GpsPosition(
            request.TenantId,
            request.DeviceId,
            request.VehicleId,
            request.Latitude,
            request.Longitude,
            request.Speed,
            request.Heading,
            request.RecordedAt,
            request.SequenceNumber
        );

        _context.Positions.Add(position);
        
        // Logic to update LatestLocationCache (Redis) would go here
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return position.Id;
    }
}

namespace GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

public class DeviceAssignment
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();

<file path="services/gps-telematics/GpsTelematics.Infrastructure/Persistence/GpsDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using GpsTelematics.Domain.Entities;

namespace GpsTelematics.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class GpsDbContext : DbContext
{
    // PostgreSQL Core Entities
    public DbSet<GpsDevice> Devices { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TelematicsDevice> TelematicsDevices { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceAssignment> DeviceAssignments { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceConnection> DeviceConnections { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TrackingSession> TrackingSessions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<RouteTrackingSession> RouteTrackingSessions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<VehicleLocation> VehicleLocations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<LocationStatusHistory> LocationStatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsPosition> GpsPositions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceHealth> DeviceHealths { get; set; } = null!;

    // Geofence & Alert Entities
    public DbSet<Geofence> Geofences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GeofenceRule> GeofenceRules { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GeofenceEvent> GeofenceEvents { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<TrackingAlert> TrackingAlerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceAlert> DeviceAlerts { get; set; } = null!;

    // Command & Integration Entities
    public DbSet<DeviceCommand> DeviceCommands { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<DeviceCommandResult> DeviceCommandResults { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsIntegrationRecord> IntegrationRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<GpsAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    
    // Outbox/Inbox
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    // Telemetry Entities (Mapped for SQL queryability, even if high-volume hits MongoDB)
    public DbSet<OdometerReading> OdometerReadings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<EngineStatus> EngineStatuses { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<FuelReading> FuelReadings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<SensorReading> SensorReadings { get; set; } = null!;

    public GpsDbContext(DbContextOptions<GpsDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
        
        // Setup PostGIS extension
        modelBuilder.HasPostgresExtension("postgis");

        // 1. PostgreSQL Core Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsDevice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.DeviceReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.DeviceSerialNumber);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.LastSeenAtUtc);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TelematicsDevice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceAssignment>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.StartAtUtc, x.EndAtUtc, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceConnection>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TrackingSession>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status, x.StartedAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.StartPosition).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.EndPosition).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<RouteTrackingSession>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.VehicleReference, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<VehicleLocation>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<LocationStatusHistory>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsPosition>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.GpsDeviceId, x.TimestampUtc, x.TrackingSessionId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceHealth>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId });
        });

        // 2. Geofence & Alert Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<Geofence>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Geometry).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Geometry).HasColumnType("geometry(Geometry,4326)");
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CenterPoint).HasMethod("GIST");
            e.Property(x => x.CenterPoint).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GeofenceRule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GeofenceId });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GeofenceEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.GeofenceId, x.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<TrackingAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.Severity, x.Status, x.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Position).HasMethod("GIST"); // Spatial Index
            e.Property(x => x.Position).HasColumnType("geography(Point,4326)");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
        });

        // 3. Command & Integration Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceCommand>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.GpsDeviceId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.CommandPayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<DeviceCommandResult>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.CommandId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.ResultPayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExternalSystem, x.ExternalReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsIntegrationRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<GpsAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // 4. Telemetry Entities
        modelBuilder.Entity<OdometerReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<EngineStatus>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<FuelReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
        modelBuilder.Entity<SensorReading>(e => e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.VehicleReference, x.TimestampUtc }));
    }
}

        if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Tenant-Code", out var tenantCodeHeader))

            var code = tenantCodeHeader.FirstOrDefault();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
            {

                // tenantContext.SetTenant(code);

        }
        else if (context.User.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            // Extract from JWT "tenant_id" claim
            var tenantClaim = context.User.FindFirst("tenant_id");
            if (tenantClaim != null)

                // tenantContext.SetTenant(Guid.Parse(tenantClaim.Value));
            }
        }

        // Call the next delegate/middleware in the pipeline
        await _next(context);

    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    
    public string TokenHash { get; set; } = string.Empty;

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Persistence/IdentityDbContext.cs">
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Ensure SmartDbContext is accessible

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IdentityDbContext : SmartDbContext
{
    public IdentityDbContext(DbContextOptions<IdentityDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<Tenant> Tenants => Set<Tenant>();
    public DbSet<Organization> Organizations => Set<Organization>();
    public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
    public DbSet<Role> Roles => Set<Role>();
    public DbSet<Permission> Permissions => Set<Permission>();
    public DbSet<UserRole> UserRoles => Set<UserRole>();
    public DbSet<RolePermission> RolePermissions => Set<RolePermission>();
    public DbSet<Session> Sessions => Set<Session>();
    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();
    public DbSet<MfaConfiguration> MfaConfigurations => Set<MfaConfiguration>();
    public DbSet<MfaRecoveryCode> MfaRecoveryCodes => Set<MfaRecoveryCode>();
    public DbSet<PasswordHistory> PasswordHistories => Set<PasswordHistory>();
    public DbSet<EmailVerificationToken> EmailVerificationTokens => Set<EmailVerificationToken>();
    public DbSet<PasswordResetToken> PasswordResetTokens => Set<PasswordResetToken>();
    public DbSet<SecurityEvent> SecurityEvents => Set<SecurityEvent>();
    public DbSet<IdentityAuditEntry> IdentityAuditEntries => Set<IdentityAuditEntry>();
    public DbSet<UserSecurityState> UserSecurityStates => Set<UserSecurityState>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Tenant
        builder.Entity<Tenant>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(t => t.TenantCode).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(t => t.Status);
            e.HasIndex(t => t.TenantType);
            e.Property(t => t.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Organization
        builder.Entity<Organization>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => new { o.TenantId, o.OrganizationCode }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(o => o.TenantId);
            e.HasIndex(o => new { o.TenantId, o.Status });
            e.HasIndex(o => o.ParentOrganizationId);
            e.Property(o => o.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            // Self-referencing FK for Parent
            e.HasOne<Organization>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(o => o.ParentOrganizationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // User
        builder.Entity<User>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(u => new { u.TenantId, u.NormalizedUsername }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(u => u.TenantId);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.OrganizationId);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.Status);
            e.HasIndex(u => u.NormalizedEmail);
            e.Property(u => u.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasOne<Tenant>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(u => u.TenantId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
            e.HasOne<Organization>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(u => u.OrganizationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Role
        builder.Entity<Role>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.NormalizedName, r.TenantId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(r => r.TenantId);
            e.Property(r => r.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Permission
        builder.Entity<Permission>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(p => p.Code).IsUnique();
        });

        // UserRole
        builder.Entity<UserRole>(e => 
        {
            e.HasKey(ur => new { ur.UserId, ur.RoleId });
            e.HasOne(ur => ur.User).WithMany().HasForeignKey(ur => ur.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasOne(ur => ur.Role).WithMany(r => r.UserRoles).HasForeignKey(ur => ur.RoleId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // RolePermission
        builder.Entity<RolePermission>(e => 
        {
            e.HasKey(rp => new { rp.RoleId, rp.PermissionId });
            e.HasOne(rp => rp.Role).WithMany(r => r.RolePermissions).HasForeignKey(rp => rp.RoleId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasOne(rp => rp.Permission).WithMany().HasForeignKey(rp => rp.PermissionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Session
        builder.Entity<Session>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(s => s.SessionReference).IsUnique();
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(s => s.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.Property(s => s.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // RefreshToken
        builder.Entity<RefreshToken>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(rt => rt.TokenHash);
            e.HasIndex(rt => rt.TokenFamilyId);
            e.HasIndex(rt => rt.UserId);
            e.HasIndex(rt => rt.SessionId);
            e.HasIndex(rt => rt.ExpiresAtUtc);
            
            e.HasOne(rt => rt.Session).WithMany(s => s.RefreshTokens).HasForeignKey(rt => rt.SessionId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(rt => rt.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // MfaConfiguration
        builder.Entity<MfaConfiguration>(e => 
        {
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(m => m.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.Property(m => m.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // MfaRecoveryCode
        builder.Entity<MfaRecoveryCode>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(m => m.MfaConfigurationId);
            e.HasIndex(m => m.Status);
            e.HasOne(m => m.MfaConfiguration).WithMany(mc => mc.RecoveryCodes).HasForeignKey(m => m.MfaConfigurationId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // PasswordHistory
        builder.Entity<PasswordHistory>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(p => new { p.UserId, p.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(p => p.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // EmailVerificationToken
        builder.Entity<EmailVerificationToken>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(evt => evt.UserId);
            e.HasIndex(evt => evt.TokenHash);
            e.HasIndex(evt => evt.ExpiresAtUtc);
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(evt => evt.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // PasswordResetToken
        builder.Entity<PasswordResetToken>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(prt => prt.UserId);
            e.HasIndex(prt => prt.TokenHash);
            e.HasOne<User>().WithMany().HasForeignKey(prt => prt.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // SecurityEvent
        builder.Entity<SecurityEvent>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(se => new { se.TenantId, se.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(se => new { se.UserId, se.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(se => se.EventType);
            e.HasIndex(se => se.Severity);
            
            e.Property(se => se.MetadataJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // IdentityAuditEntry
        builder.Entity<IdentityAuditEntry>(e => 
        {
            e.HasIndex(ia => new { ia.TenantId, ia.OccurredAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(ia => ia.ActorUserId);
            e.HasIndex(ia => new { ia.ResourceType, ia.ResourceId });
            
            e.Property(ia => ia.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(ia => ia.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // UserSecurityState
        builder.Entity<UserSecurityState>(e => 
        {
            e.HasOne(uss => uss.User).WithMany().HasForeignKey(uss => uss.UserId).OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
            e.Property(uss => uss.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/Argon2PasswordHasher.cs">
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Cryptography.KeyDerivation;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class Argon2PasswordHasher : IPasswordHasher
{
    // In a real .NET 8+ app, you might use BCrypt.Net-Next or a native Argon2 library.
    // This is a placeholder using PBKDF2 to demonstrate the interface implementation.
    
    public string HashPassword(string password)
    {
        byte[] salt = RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(128 / 8); 

        string hashed = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: password,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 100000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

        return $"{Convert.ToBase64String(salt)}.{hashed}";
    }

    public bool VerifyPassword(string password, string hash)
    {
        var parts = hash.Split('.', 2);
        if (parts.Length != 2) return false;

        var salt = Convert.FromBase64String(parts[0]);
        var expectedHash = parts[1];

        string actualHash = Convert.ToBase64String(KeyDerivation.Pbkdf2(
            password: password,
            salt: salt,
            prf: KeyDerivationPrf.HMACSHA256,
            iterationCount: 100000,
            numBytesRequested: 256 / 8));

        return expectedHash == actualHash;
    }
}

<file path="services/identity/Identity.Infrastructure/Security/JwtTokenGenerator.cs">
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using Identity.Application.Interfaces;
using Identity.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace Identity.Infrastructure.Security;

public class JwtTokenGenerator : IJwtTokenGenerator
{
    private readonly string _secretKey = "SUPER_SECRET_KEY_THAT_SHOULD_BE_IN_VAULT_NOT_HERE";
    private readonly string _issuer = "SmartTradePlatform";
    private readonly string _audience = "SmartTradeServices";

    public string GenerateAccessToken(User user, Tenant tenant, IEnumerable<string> permissions)
    {
        var securityKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_secretKey));
        var credentials = new SigningCredentials(securityKey, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

        var claims = new List<Claim>
        {
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
            new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Email, user.Email),
            new Claim("tenant_id", tenant.Id.ToString()),
            new Claim("tenant_code", tenant.Code)
        };

        if (user.OrganizationId.HasValue)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("organization_id", user.OrganizationId.Value.ToString()));
        }

        foreach (var permission in permissions)
        {
            claims.Add(new Claim("permissions", permission));
        }

        var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
            issuer: _issuer,
            audience: _audience,
            claims: claims,
            expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15), // Short-lived
            signingCredentials: credentials);

        return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
    }

    public string GenerateRefreshToken()
    {
        var randomNumber = new byte[32];
        using var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(randomNumber);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(randomNumber);
    }

    public string HashToken(string token)
    {
        using var sha256 = SHA256.Create();
        var hashedBytes = sha256.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(token));
        return Convert.ToBase64String(hashedBytes);
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Api/Controllers/WebhooksController.cs">
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Integration.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Integration.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/integration/webhooks")]
// Webhooks often use custom auth (like HMAC signatures on the payload), so standard JWT Authorize might be bypassed here in favor of middleware/ActionFilters
[AllowAnonymous] 
public class WebhooksController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public WebhooksController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("{partnerCode}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ReceiveWebhook(string partnerCode)
    {
        // Extract raw body for signature validation
        using var reader = new StreamReader(Request.Body, Encoding.UTF8);
        var payload = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
        
        // Extract headers
        var signature = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].ToString();
        var timestampHeader = Request.Headers["X-Timestamp"].ToString();
        
        DateTime? timestamp = null;
        if (long.TryParse(timestampHeader, out var ts))
        {
            timestamp = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(ts).UtcDateTime;
        }

        var command = new ProcessWebhookCommand
        {
            // Usually derived from the URL or specific headers for webhooks
            TenantId = Guid.Empty, // Would be resolved via PartnerCode mapping in the command handler
            PartnerCode = partnerCode,
            Payload = payload,
            Signature = signature,
            Timestamp = timestamp
        };

        var result = await _mediator.Send(command);

        if (result)
        {
            // Always return fast HTTP 202 to the external partner to prevent timeout retries
            return Accepted(new { Status = "Received", Message = "Webhook payload accepted for asynchronous processing." });
        }
        
        return BadRequest(new { Error = "Invalid webhook payload or signature." });
    }
}

<file path="services/integration/Integration.Domain/Entities/InboxMessage.cs">
namespace Integration.Domain.Entities;

public class InboxMessage
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid MessageId { get; set; }
