<file path="services/integration/Integration.Infrastructure/Persistence/IntegrationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Integration.Domain.Entities;

namespace Integration.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class IntegrationDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Integration Core
    public DbSet<IntegrationPartner> Partners { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationSystem> Systems { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEndpoint> Endpoints { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAuthentication> Authentications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationApiVersion> ApiVersions { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Events & Contracts
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventContract> EventContracts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventSubscription> EventSubscriptions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationEventDelivery> EventDeliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationMessage> Messages { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. API & Webhooks
    public DbSet<IntegrationRequest> Requests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookSubscription> WebhookSubscriptions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookDelivery> WebhookDeliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<WebhookInboundEvent> WebhookInboundEvents { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Resiliency & Policy
    public DbSet<IntegrationMapping> Mappings { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationRetryPolicy> RetryPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationDeadLetter> DeadLetters { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationIdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationRateLimitPolicy> RateLimitPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationCircuitState> CircuitStates { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Operations & Health
    public DbSet<IntegrationHealthRecord> HealthRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationJob> Jobs { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationFileExchange> FileExchanges { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Verification & Transformation
    public DbSet<IntegrationSchemaValidation> SchemaValidations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationTransformationRecord> TransformationRecords { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Integrations & Platform Base
    public DbSet<IntegrationExternalReference> ExternalReferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<IntegrationAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;

    public IntegrationDbContext(DbContextOptions<IntegrationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 1. Integration Core
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationPartner>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PartnerReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationSystem>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.PartnerId, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationEndpoint>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationAuthentication>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.AuthenticationReference }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationApiVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.Version }).IsUnique();
        });

        // 2. Events & Contracts
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationEventContract>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ContractReference, x.SchemaVersion }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.SchemaJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationEventSubscription>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ContractId, x.SubscriberSystem });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationEventDelivery>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.MessageId, x.EventType, x.TargetSystem });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.OccurredAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.MessageId, x.Direction });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        // 3. API & Webhooks
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationRequest>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointId, x.CorrelationId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.RequestTimestampUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<WebhookSubscription>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PartnerId, x.WebhookReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.EventType);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<WebhookDelivery>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.WebhookSubscriptionId, x.EventId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<WebhookInboundEvent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PartnerId, x.ProviderEventId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        // 4. Resiliency & Policy
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationMapping>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.MappingReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.ConfigurationJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationRetryPolicy>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PolicyReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.RetryableStatusCodesJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.RetryableErrorCodesJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationDeadLetter>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status, x.CreatedAtUtc });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.TargetSystem, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationIdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.IdempotencyKey, x.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationRateLimitPolicy>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointId }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationCircuitState>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointId }).IsUnique();
        });

        // 5. Operations & Health
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationHealthRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.SystemId, x.EndpointId, x.CheckedAtUtc });
            e.Property(x => x.DetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationAlert>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Severity, x.Status, x.OccurredAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationJob>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.JobType, x.Status });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationFileExchange>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.PartnerId, x.FileReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        // 6. Verification & Transformation
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationSchemaValidation>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.MessageId, x.ValidationDirection });
            e.Property(x => x.ValidationErrorsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationTransformationRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.MessageId, x.MappingId });
        });

        // 7. Integrations & Platform Base
        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationExternalReference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.InternalSystem, x.InternalResourceType, x.InternalResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ExternalSystem, x.ExternalReference });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<IntegrationAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
    }
}

<file path="services/notification/Notification.Infrastructure/Persistence/NotificationDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Notification.Domain.Entities;

namespace Notification.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class NotificationDbContext : DbContext
{
    // 1. Notification Core & Recipients
    public DbSet<Domain.Entities.Notification> Notifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationRecipient> Recipients { get; set; } = null!;

    // 2. Channels
    public DbSet<NotificationChannel> Channels { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<EmailNotification> EmailNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<SmsNotification> SmsNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<PushNotification> PushNotifications { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InAppNotification> InAppNotifications { get; set; } = null!;

    // 3. Templates & Rules
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplate> Templates { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplateVersion> TemplateVersions { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationTemplateApproval> TemplateApprovals { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationRule> Rules { get; set; } = null!;

    // 4. Preferences & Quiet Hours
    public DbSet<NotificationPreference> Preferences { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationChannelPreference> ChannelPreferences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 5. Delivery & Status
    public DbSet<NotificationRequest> Requests { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDelivery> Deliveries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDeliveryAttempt> DeliveryAttempts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationReadState> ReadStates { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationStatusHistory> StatusHistories { get; set; } = null!;

    // 6. Provider Integrations
    public DbSet<NotificationProviderCallback> ProviderCallbacks { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationProviderReference> ProviderReferences { get; set; } = null!;

    // 7. Scheduling & Broadcast
    public DbSet<NotificationSchedule> Schedules { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationBroadcast> Broadcasts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationBroadcastRecipient> BroadcastRecipients { get; set; } = null!;

    // 8. Resiliency & Audit
    public DbSet<NotificationRetryPolicy> RetryPolicies { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationDeadLetter> DeadLetters { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationIdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAlert> Alerts { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAuditEntry> AuditEntries { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages { get; set; } = null!;

    // 9. Attachments & Escalation
    public DbSet<NotificationEscalation> Escalations { get; set; } = null!;
    public DbSet<NotificationAttachment> Attachments { get; set; } = null!;

    public NotificationDbContext(DbContextOptions<NotificationDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        // 1. Notification
        modelBuilder.Entity<Domain.Entities.Notification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationType });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Priority });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.CreatedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ScheduledAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ExpiresAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.SourceService);
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRecipient>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.UserReference });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.ReadAtUtc });
        });

        // 2. Channels
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationChannel>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.RecipientId, x.ChannelType });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<EmailNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<SmsNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<PushNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId });
            e.Property(x => x.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<InAppNotification>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.RecipientId, x.IsRead });
        });

        // 3. Templates & Rules
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationTemplate>(e =>
        {
            // Note: TenantId can be null for global templates, so we don't index as composite unique trivially unless we handle nulls.
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TemplateReference, x.TenantId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationType, x.ChannelType, x.LanguageCode, x.Status });
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationTemplateVersion>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TemplateId, x.VersionNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.VariablesSchemaJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRule>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RuleReference }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.ConditionsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // 4. Preferences
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationPreference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.NotificationType }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationChannelPreference>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.UserReference, x.NotificationType, x.ChannelType }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // 5. Delivery
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationRequest>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.RequestReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.IdempotencyKey });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationDelivery>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.ChannelId });
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status });

            e.HasIndex(x => x.LastAttemptAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationDeliveryAttempt>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(x => x.AttemptedAtUtc);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationReadState>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.NotificationId, x.UserReference }).IsUnique();
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationStatusHistory>(e =>

        });

        // 6. Providers
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationProviderCallback>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.ProviderName, x.ProviderEventId }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(x => x.ReceivedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(x => x.Status);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationProviderReference>(e =>

        });

        // 7. Scheduling & Broadcast
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationSchedule>(e =>

            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.Status, x.NextRunAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationBroadcast>(e =>

        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationBroadcastRecipient>(e =>

        });

        // 8. Resiliency & Audit
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationIdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.IdempotencyKey, x.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(x => x.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationDeadLetter>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.Status, x.CreatedAtUtc });
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationAuditEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(x => new { x.TenantId, x.ResourceType, x.ResourceId });
            e.HasIndex(x => x.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(x => x.BeforeJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(x => x.AfterJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        modelBuilder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {

            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);

        // 9. Attachments & Escalation
        modelBuilder.Entity<NotificationEscalation>(e =>

        });

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Api/Controllers/PaymentIntentsController.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using MediatR;
using Payment.Application.Commands;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

namespace Payment.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/intents")]
[Authorize]
public class PaymentIntentsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public PaymentIntentsController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.create")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateIntent([FromBody] CreatePaymentIntentCommand command)
    {
        if (User.HasClaim(c => c.Type == "tenantId"))
        {
            command.TenantId = Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst("tenantId").Value);
        }

        var intentId = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return CreatedAtAction(nameof(GetIntent), new { id = intentId }, new { IntentId = intentId });
    }

    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    [Authorize(Policy = "payment.intent.read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetIntent(Guid id)
    {
        return Ok(new { Id = id, Status = "Pending" });
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Application/Commands/CreatePaymentIntentCommand.cs">
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using MediatR;
using FluentValidation;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Application.Commands;

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommand : IRequest<Guid>
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string ExternalReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceSystem { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceAggregateId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public Guid CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public decimal Amount { get; set; }
    public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD";
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
}

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<CreatePaymentIntentCommand>
{
    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.TenantId).NotEmpty().WithMessage("TenantId is required.");
        RuleFor(x => x.Amount).GreaterThan(0).WithMessage("Amount must be greater than zero.");
        RuleFor(x => x.Currency).NotEmpty().Length(3).WithMessage("Currency must be a 3-letter code.");
        RuleFor(x => x.SourceSystem).NotEmpty().WithMessage("SourceSystem is required.");
    }
}

public interface IPaymentDbContext
{
    void AddPaymentIntent(PaymentIntent intent);
    Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public class CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CreatePaymentIntentCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IPaymentDbContext _context;

    public CreatePaymentIntentCommandHandler(IPaymentDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreatePaymentIntentCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var paymentReference = $"PAY-{DateTime.UtcNow:yyyyMMdd}-{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8).ToUpper()}";
        
        var money = new Money(request.Amount, request.Currency);

        var intent = new PaymentIntent(
            request.TenantId,
            paymentReference,
            request.SourceSystem,
            request.SourceAggregateId,
            request.CustomsCaseId,
            request.DeclarationNumber,
            request.ECTNNumber,
            money,
            request.DueDate
        );

        _context.AddPaymentIntent(intent);
        
        await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return intent.Id;
    }
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/PaymentIntent.cs">
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class PaymentIntent
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? CustomerAccountId { get; set; }
    
    public string IntentReference { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SourceSystem { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Declaration, Customs, ECTN
    public string SourceReferenceId { get; set; } = string.Empty; // e.g. CustomsAssessmentId
    public Guid? CustomsCaseId { get; set; }
    public string DeclarationNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string ECTNNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public decimal AmountRequested { get; set; }
    public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public string Status { get; set; } = "Created"; // Created, RequiresPaymentMethod, Processing, Succeeded, Canceled, Failed
    
    public Guid? GatewayConfigurationId { get; set; }
    public string GatewayIntentId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime UpdatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? ExpiresAtUtc { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    
    public string MetadataJson { get; set; } = "{}"; // JSONB
    
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

    public ICollection<PaymentTransaction> Transactions { get; set; } = new List<PaymentTransaction>();

    public PaymentIntent() { }

    public PaymentIntent(
        Guid tenantId,
        string intentReference,
        string sourceSystem,
        string sourceReferenceId,
        Guid customsCaseId,
        string declarationNumber,
        string ectnNumber,
        Money money,
        DateTime? dueDate = null)
    {
        TenantId = tenantId;
        IntentReference = intentReference;
        SourceSystem = sourceSystem;
        SourceReferenceId = sourceReferenceId;
        CustomsCaseId = customsCaseId;
        DeclarationNumber = declarationNumber ?? string.Empty;
        ECTNNumber = ectnNumber ?? string.Empty;
        AmountRequested = money.Amount;
        CurrencyCode = money.Currency;
        Status = "Created";
        DueDate = dueDate;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Process()
    {
        if (Status != "Created" && Status != "RequiresPaymentMethod")
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Cannot process payment intent in state '{Status}'.");
        Status = "Processing";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void MarkSucceeded(PaymentTransaction transaction)
    {
        if (Status == "Succeeded") return;
        if (Status == "Canceled") throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot succeed a canceled payment intent.");

        Status = "Succeeded";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        if (transaction != null && !Transactions.Contains(transaction))
        {
            Transactions.Add(transaction);
        }
    }

    public void MarkFailed(string reason)
    {
        Status = "Failed";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }

    public void Cancel()
    {
        if (Status == "Succeeded") throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot cancel an already succeeded payment.");
        Status = "Canceled";
        UpdatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/Entities/PaymentTransaction.cs">
namespace Payment.Domain.Entities;

public class PaymentTransaction
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid PaymentIntentId { get; set; }
    
    public string TransactionType { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Authorization, Capture, Refund, Void, Chargeback
    public string Status { get; set; } = "Pending"; // Pending, Success, Failed
    
    public decimal Amount { get; set; }
    public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public string GatewayTransactionId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string GatewayResponseCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string GatewayResponseMessage { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    
    public string PaymentMethodType { get; set; } = string.Empty; // Card, BankTransfer, MobileMoney, Cash, Wallet
    public string PaymentMethodDetailsJson { get; set; } = "{}"; // JSONB
    
    public DateTime ProcessedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    
    public byte[] Version { get; set; } = Array.Empty<byte>();

    public PaymentIntent PaymentIntent { get; set; } = null!;
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Domain/ValueObjects/Money.cs">
using System;

namespace Payment.Domain.ValueObjects;

public class Money : IEquatable<Money>
{
    public decimal Amount { get; private set; }
    public string Currency { get; private set; }

    protected Money() { }

    public Money(decimal amount, string currency)
    {
        if (amount < 0) throw new ArgumentException("Amount cannot be negative", nameof(amount));
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currency)) throw new ArgumentException("Currency must be specified", nameof(currency));

        Amount = Math.Round(amount, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero); // Default rounding policy for now
        Currency = currency.ToUpperInvariant();
    }

    public static Money Zero(string currency) => new Money(0, currency);

    public Money Add(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add different currencies");
        return new Money(Amount + other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public Money Subtract(Money other)
    {
        if (Currency != other.Currency)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract different currencies");
        if (Amount < other.Amount)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot subtract to a negative amount");
        return new Money(Amount - other.Amount, Currency);
    }

    public bool Equals(Money other)
    {
        if (other is null) return false;
        return Amount == other.Amount && Currency == other.Currency;
    }

    public override bool Equals(object obj) => Equals(obj as Money);

    public override int GetHashCode() => HashCode.Combine(Amount, Currency);
}

<file path="services/payment/Payment.Infrastructure/Persistence/PaymentDbContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Payment.Domain.Entities;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Billing;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Configuration;
using Payment.Domain.Entities.Integration;
using BuildingBlocks.Persistence; // Base SmartDbContext

namespace Payment.Infrastructure.Persistence;

public class PaymentDbContext : SmartDbContext
{
    public PaymentDbContext(DbContextOptions<PaymentDbContext> options) : base(options) { }

    // Core
    public DbSet<PaymentIntent> PaymentIntents => Set<PaymentIntent>();
    public DbSet<PaymentTransaction> PaymentTransactions => Set<PaymentTransaction>();
    public DbSet<LedgerEntry> LedgerEntries => Set<LedgerEntry>();
    
    // Billing
    public DbSet<Invoice> Invoices => Set<Invoice>();
    public DbSet<InvoiceLineItem> InvoiceLineItems => Set<InvoiceLineItem>();
    public DbSet<Receipt> Receipts => Set<Receipt>();
    public DbSet<CustomerAccount> CustomerAccounts => Set<CustomerAccount>();
    
    // Configuration
    public DbSet<PaymentGatewayConfiguration> PaymentGatewayConfigurations => Set<PaymentGatewayConfiguration>();
    public DbSet<PaymentMethodConfiguration> PaymentMethodConfigurations => Set<PaymentMethodConfiguration>();
    
    // Integration
    public DbSet<OutboxMessage> OutboxMessages => Set<OutboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<InboxMessage> InboxMessages => Set<InboxMessage>();
    public DbSet<IdempotencyRecord> IdempotencyRecords => Set<IdempotencyRecord>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder builder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(builder);

        // Payment Intent
        builder.Entity<PaymentIntent>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pi => new { pi.TenantId, pi.IntentReference }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(pi => new { pi.SourceSystem, pi.SourceReferenceId });
            e.HasIndex(pi => pi.Status);
            e.HasIndex(pi => pi.CreatedAtUtc);
            
            e.Property(pi => pi.AmountRequested).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pi => pi.MetadataJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pi => pi.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(pi => pi.Transactions)
             .WithOne(t => t.PaymentIntent)
             .HasForeignKey(t => t.PaymentIntentId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        // Payment Transaction
        builder.Entity<PaymentTransaction>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pt => pt.GatewayTransactionId);
            e.HasIndex(pt => pt.Status);
            
            e.Property(pt => pt.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pt => pt.PaymentMethodDetailsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pt => pt.Version).IsRowVersion();
        });

        // Ledger Entry (Immutable)
        builder.Entity<LedgerEntry>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(le => new { le.TenantId, le.CustomerAccountId });
            e.HasIndex(le => le.PostedAtUtc);
            e.HasIndex(le => le.Hash).IsUnique();
            
            e.Property(le => le.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            // Ledger entries should never be updated or cascade deleted
        });

        // Billing
        builder.Entity<CustomerAccount>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(ca => new { ca.TenantId, ca.AccountNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(ca => ca.OrganizationId);
            
            e.Property(ca => ca.CreditLimit).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.AvailableCredit).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.CurrentBalance).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(ca => ca.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(ca => ca.Invoices)
             .WithOne(i => i.CustomerAccount)
             .HasForeignKey(i => i.CustomerAccountId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        builder.Entity<Invoice>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.InvoiceNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.SourceSystem, i.SourceReferenceId });
            e.HasIndex(i => i.Status);
            
            e.Property(i => i.SubtotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TaxAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.AmountPaid).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.AmountDue).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(i => i.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(i => i.LineItems)
             .WithOne(li => li.Invoice)
             .HasForeignKey(li => li.InvoiceId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<InvoiceLineItem>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(li => li.Quantity).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.UnitPrice).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TaxRate).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TaxAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(li => li.TotalAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        builder.Entity<Receipt>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(r => new { r.TenantId, r.ReceiptNumber }).IsUnique();
            e.HasIndex(r => r.PaymentTransactionId);
            
            e.Property(r => r.Amount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(r => r.MetadataJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            
            e.HasOne(r => r.Invoice)
             .WithMany()
             .HasForeignKey(r => r.InvoiceId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);
        });

        // Configuration
        builder.Entity<PaymentGatewayConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(pg => new { pg.TenantId, pg.GatewayName });
            
            e.Property(pg => pg.SupportedCurrenciesJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pg => pg.AdditionalSettingsJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
            e.Property(pg => pg.Version).IsRowVersion();
            
            e.HasMany(pg => pg.SupportedMethods)
             .WithOne(pm => pm.Gateway)
             .HasForeignKey(pm => pm.PaymentGatewayConfigurationId)
             .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
        });

        builder.Entity<PaymentMethodConfiguration>(e =>
        {
            e.Property(pm => pm.ProcessingFeePercentage).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.FixedProcessingFee).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.MinimumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
            e.Property(pm => pm.MaximumAmount).HasColumnType("numeric(19,4)");
        });

        // Idempotency
        builder.Entity<IdempotencyRecord>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.TenantId, i.IdempotencyKey, i.Operation }).IsUnique();
            e.Property(i => i.ResponseBodyJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });

        // Inbox / Outbox
        builder.Entity<InboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(i => new { i.MessageId, i.Consumer }).IsUnique();
        });
        
        builder.Entity<OutboxMessage>(e =>
        {
            e.HasIndex(o => o.Status);
            e.HasIndex(o => o.OccurredAtUtc);
            e.Property(o => o.PayloadJson).HasColumnType("jsonb");
        });
    }
}

using System;

namespace BuildingBlocks.Infrastructure.Messaging;

public enum OutboxMessageStatus
{
    Pending,
    Processing,
    Published,
    Failed,
    DeadLetter
}

public class OutboxMessage
{
    public Guid Id { get; private set; }
    public string EventType { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public int EventVersion { get; private set; }
    public string AggregateId { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Payload { get; private set; } = string.Empty;
    public DateTime OccurredAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? PublishedAtUtc { get; private set; }
    public int RetryCount { get; private set; }
    public OutboxMessageStatus Status { get; private set; }
    public string? LastError { get; private set; }
    public Guid CorrelationId { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }

    protected OutboxMessage() { } // EF Core

    public OutboxMessage(Guid id, string eventType, int eventVersion, string aggregateId, string payload, Guid correlationId, Guid tenantId)
    {
        Id = id;
        EventType = eventType;
        EventVersion = eventVersion;
        AggregateId = aggregateId;
        Payload = payload;
        OccurredAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        CreatedAtUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        Status = OutboxMessageStatus.Pending;
        RetryCount = 0;
        CorrelationId = correlationId;
        TenantId = tenantId;
    }
}

<file path="tests/Ectn.UnitTests/Domain/EctnAggregateTests.cs">
using System;
using Xunit;
using FluentAssertions;
using Ectn.Domain.Entities;
using Ectn.Domain.Enums;
using EctnEntity = Ectn.Domain.Entities.Ectn;

namespace Ectn.UnitTests.Domain;

public class EctnAggregateTests
{
    // ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static EctnEntity CreateDraftEctn(Guid? tenantId = null, Guid? actorId = null)
    {
        return new EctnEntity(
            tenantId ?? Guid.NewGuid(),
            "APP-REF-001",
            EctnType.Standard,
            actorId ?? Guid.NewGuid()
        );
    }

    // ─── Construction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_Should_CreateDraftEctn_WithValidInputs()
    {
        var tenantId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();

        var ectn = new EctnEntity(tenantId, "APP-REF-100", EctnType.Containerized, actorId);

        ectn.Id.Should().NotBe(Guid.Empty);
        ectn.TenantId.Should().Be(tenantId);
        ectn.ApplicationReference.Should().Be("APP-REF-100");
        ectn.Type.Should().Be(EctnType.Containerized);
        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Draft);
        ectn.CreatedBy.Should().Be(actorId);
        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().ContainSingle(h => h.Status == EctnStatus.Draft);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_Should_Throw_When_TenantIdIsEmpty()
    {
        Action act = () => new EctnEntity(Guid.Empty, "APP-REF-001", EctnType.Standard, Guid.NewGuid());
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("tenantId");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_Should_Throw_When_ApplicationReferenceIsEmpty()
    {
        Action act = () => new EctnEntity(Guid.NewGuid(), "", EctnType.Standard, Guid.NewGuid());
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("applicationReference");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_Should_Throw_When_CreatedByIsEmpty()
    {
        Action act = () => new EctnEntity(Guid.NewGuid(), "APP-REF-001", EctnType.Standard, Guid.Empty);
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("createdBy");
    }

    // ─── Submit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Submit_Should_ChangeStatusToSubmitted_When_StatusIsDraft()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);

        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Submitted);
        ectn.SubmittedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().Contain(h => h.Status == EctnStatus.Submitted);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Submit_Should_ThrowException_When_StatusIsNotDraft()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId); // now Submitted

        Action act = () => ectn.Submit(actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("Only draft ECTNs can be submitted.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Submit_Should_RecordStatusHistoryEntry()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);

        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().HaveCount(2); // Draft + Submitted
        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().ContainSingle(h =>
            h.Status == EctnStatus.Submitted && h.ChangedBy == actorId);
    }

    // ─── StartReview ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void StartReview_Should_SetStatusToUnderReview_When_Submitted()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        ectn.StartReview(actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.UnderReview);
        ectn.ReviewedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void StartReview_Should_Throw_When_StatusIsNotSubmitted()
    {
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn();

        Action act = () => ectn.StartReview(Guid.NewGuid());
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("Only submitted ECTNs can be placed under review.");
    }

    // ─── Approve ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Approve_Should_SetStatusToApproved_When_UnderReview()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.StartReview(actorId);

        ectn.Approve(actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Approved);
        ectn.ApprovedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Approve_Should_SetStatusToApproved_When_Submitted()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        ectn.Approve(actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Approved);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Approve_Should_Throw_When_StatusIsDraft()
    {
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn();

        Action act = () => ectn.Approve(Guid.NewGuid());
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("ECTN must be Submitted or Under Review to be approved.");
    }

    // ─── Issue ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Issue_Should_SetStatusToIssued_And_AssignEctnNumber_When_Approved()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.Approve(actorId);

        ectn.Issue("ECTN-2026-000001", actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Issued);
        ectn.EctnNumber.Should().Be("ECTN-2026-000001");
        ectn.IssuedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Issue_Should_Throw_When_StatusIsNotApproved()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        Action act = () => ectn.Issue("ECTN-2026-000001", actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("Only approved ECTNs can be issued.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Issue_Should_Throw_When_EctnNumberIsEmpty()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.Approve(actorId);

        Action act = () => ectn.Issue("", actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("ectnNumber");
    }

    // ─── Reject ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Reject_Should_SetStatusToRejected_With_Reason()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        ectn.Reject("Missing Bill of Lading.", actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Rejected);
        ectn.RejectionReason.Should().Be("Missing Bill of Lading.");
        ectn.RejectedAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reject_Should_Throw_When_EctnIsAlreadyIssued()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.Approve(actorId);
        ectn.Issue("ECTN-2026-000001", actorId);

        Action act = () => ectn.Reject("Invalid", actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("Cannot reject an ECTN that is already Issued, Cancelled, or Expired.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reject_Should_Throw_When_ReasonIsEmpty()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);

        Action act = () => ectn.Reject("", actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("reason");
    }

    // ─── Cancel ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_Should_SetStatusToCancelled_From_Draft()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);

        ectn.Cancel("Applicant withdrew.", actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Cancelled);
        ectn.CancellationReason.Should().Be("Applicant withdrew.");
        ectn.CancelledAt.Should().BeCloseTo(DateTime.UtcNow, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_Should_SetStatusToCancelled_From_Issued()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.Approve(actorId);
        ectn.Issue("ECTN-2026-000001", actorId);

        ectn.Cancel("Duplicate submission.", actorId);

        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Cancelled);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_Should_Throw_When_AlreadyCancelled()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);
        ectn.Cancel("First cancellation.", actorId);

        Action act = () => ectn.Cancel("Second cancellation.", actorId);
        act.Should().Throw<InvalidOperationException>()
           .WithMessage("ECTN is already cancelled or expired.");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Cancel_Should_Throw_When_ReasonIsEmpty()
    {
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn();

        Action act = () => ectn.Cancel("", Guid.NewGuid());
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("reason");
    }

    // ─── Full Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    [Fact]
    public void FullLifecycle_Draft_Submit_Review_Approve_Issue_Should_HaveSixHistoryEntries()
    {
        var actorId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn(actorId: actorId);

        ectn.Submit(actorId);
        ectn.StartReview(actorId);
        ectn.Approve(actorId);
        ectn.Issue("ECTN-2026-FULL-001", actorId);

        ectn.StatusHistories.Should().HaveCount(5); // Draft + Submitted + UnderReview + Approved + Issued
        ectn.Status.Should().Be(EctnStatus.Issued);
        ectn.EctnNumber.Should().Be("ECTN-2026-FULL-001");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void EctnNumber_Should_BeAssignable_WithAssignEctnNumber_Method()
    {
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn();

        ectn.AssignEctnNumber("ECTN-2026-ASSIGN-001");

        ectn.EctnNumber.Should().Be("ECTN-2026-ASSIGN-001");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AssignEctnNumber_Should_Throw_When_NumberIsEmpty()
    {
        var ectn = CreateDraftEctn();

        Action act = () => ectn.AssignEctnNumber("   ");
        act.Should().Throw<ArgumentException>().WithParameterName("ectnNumber");
    }
}
</file>

<file path="run-migrations.ps1">
$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$services = @(
    "identity", "payment", "customs", "fleet", "declaration", 
    "ectn", "corridor", "gps-telematics", "ais-vessel", "anpr-gate", 
    "audit", "notification", "integration", "analytics"
)

foreach ($svc in $services) {
    Write-Host "========================================="
    Write-Host "Processing Service: $svc"
    
    # Capitalize first letter to match project naming conventions usually
    $SvcCapital = (Get-Culture).TextInfo.ToTitleCase($svc)
    
    if ($svc -eq "gps-telematics") { $SvcCapital = "GpsTelematics" }
    if ($svc -eq "ais-vessel") { $SvcCapital = "AisVessel" }
    if ($svc -eq "anpr-gate") { $SvcCapital = "AnprGate" }
    
    $apiProject = "services/$svc/$SvcCapital.Api"
    $infraProject = "services/$svc/$SvcCapital.Infrastructure"
    
    if ((Test-Path $apiProject) -and (Test-Path $infraProject)) {
        Write-Host "Adding Migration for $svc..."
        dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
        
        Write-Host "Updating Database for $svc..."
        dotnet ef database update --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject
    } else {
        Write-Host "Skipping $svc - Project paths not found"
    }
}
Write-Host "Done!"
</file>

<file path="run-migrations.sh">
#!/bin/bash
set -e

services=("identity" "payment" "customs" "fleet" "declaration" "ectn" "corridor" "gps-telematics" "ais-vessel" "anpr-gate" "audit" "notification" "integration" "analytics")

for svc in "${services[@]}"; do
    echo "========================================="
    echo "Processing Service: $svc"
    
    # Capitalize the service name to match folder names (e.g., identity -> Identity)
    if [ "$svc" == "gps-telematics" ]; then
        svc_capital="GpsTelematics"
    elif [ "$svc" == "ais-vessel" ]; then
        svc_capital="AisVessel"
    elif [ "$svc" == "anpr-gate" ]; then
        svc_capital="AnprGate"
    else
        # Capitalize first letter
        svc_capital="$(tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' <<< ${svc:0:1})${svc:1}"
    fi

    apiProject="services/$svc/$svc_capital.Api"
    infraProject="services/$svc/$svc_capital.Infrastructure"
    
    if [ -d "$apiProject" ] && [ -d "$infraProject" ]; then
        echo "Adding Migration for $svc..."
        dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject --output-dir Persistence/Migrations || true
        
        echo "Updating Database for $svc..."
        dotnet ef database update --project $infraProject --startup-project $apiProject || true
    else
        echo "Skipping $svc - Project paths not found"
    fi
done

echo "Done!"
</file>
